Station Street (0.2–1.8 km) was smoother than Station Street (0.0–0.2 km) and felt mildly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.0 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 0.9 km mark. There was also probably a bump around the 1.3 km mark. Station Street (1.8–2.5 km) was rougher than Station Street (0.2–1.8 km) and felt fairly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.3 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 2.0 km mark. There was also a sharp bump around the 2.4 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. Weavers Way was smoother than Station Street (1.8–2.5 km) and felt mildly bumpy (0.32 m/s² weighted). It runs near City Library. There was possibly a jolt around the 3.3 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The roughest stretch was Beacon Way (5.0–6.8 km), which felt fairly bumpy (0.79 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.1 m/s². There were two bumps around the 5.6 and 5.7 km marks. There was also possibly a jolt around the 6.7 km mark. On Beacon Way (6.8–8.1 km) the surface is in fair condition, and overall it felt noticeably bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.6 m/s². There was likely a bump around the 7.0 km mark. There was also a hard bump around the 7.9 km mark. Chapel Street is in good condition and felt a little uncomfortable at about 61 km/h. It runs near Town Hall. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.7 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as asphalt. There were two sharp bumps. The other stretch (1.7 km) was perfectly comfortable, with two lower-priority events.

narrative: Church Lane felt fairly uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There was likely a bump. A jolt may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. There may also have been a bump. Signal Way was smoother than Church Lane and felt slightly uncomfortable. It runs near Old Mill. It was jarring in places. There were two sharp bumps. On Ashgrove Road the ride was rough. It was jarring in places. There may have been a jolt. There were also two bumps. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. Pottery Lane felt fairly uncomfortable mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in good condition. It was jarring in places. There was likely a bump. A jolt may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. There may also have been a swerve, possibly around an obstacle. On Bridge Street the ride was punishing. It was jarring in places. There was probably a bump. There were also two sharp bumps. Copper Street was the smoothest stretch and felt perfectly comfortable. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump as you braked. There was also a hard bump. The other stretch was uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Gentler braking and a slower pace on Bridge Street would help most.

narrative:
Trip report: 8.4 km drive, 15 minutes.
Without a gyroscope, steering events could not be checked.
- Lantern Lane (0.0–1.7 km), 1.7 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.40 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; there may have been a bump around the 0.7 km mark.
- Willow Drive (3.4–3.8 km), 400 m: ride bumpy (0.97 m/s²) at about 15 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; near Market Hall; there was a sharp bump around the 3.6 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Granary Lane (3.8–4.7 km), 900 m: ride extremely uncomfortable (2.9 m/s²) at about 29 km/h; surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 11.0 m/s²; near General Hospital; there was a bump around the 4.2 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 4.6 km mark.
- Beacon Way (4.7–5.5 km), 880 m: ride very bumpy (1.7 m/s²); surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.1 m/s²; there was possibly a bump around the 4.9 km mark; there were two bumps around the 5.3 and 5.5 km marks.
- the stretch from 7.2 to 8.4 km, 1.2 km: ride extremely uncomfortable (3.5 m/s²); surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 9.6 m/s²; there were two sharp bumps around the 7.4 and 8.1 km marks; no street name in the map.
- The remaining three stretches, 3.3 km: ride perfectly comfortable to fairly uncomfortable; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Willow Drive (3.4–3.8 km) for a maintenance review.

- The remaining stretch, 550 m: ride fairly bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Mill Road (0.0–1.4 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 10.1 km run took 16 minutes. Beacon Way was the smoothest stretch and felt calm. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.65 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as asphalt. There was a hard bump. School Lane was rougher than Beacon Way and felt rough. It runs near Sports Ground. There was possibly a jolt around the 2.4 km mark. On Church Lane (3.2–5.4 km) the surface is in poor condition, and at about 39 km/h it felt uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.9 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as asphalt. There was likely a bump around the 3.5 km mark. There may also have been a bump around the 4.7 km mark. Church Lane (5.4–7.0 km) felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 71 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition. It runs near Post Office. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.6 m/s². There was a bump around the 6.5 km mark. Church Lane (7.0–8.4 km) is in poor condition and felt bumpy at about 69 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.5 m/s². There was possibly a jolt around the 7.2 km mark. There was also a bump around the 7.5 km mark. The ride on Hill Road (1.5 km) was bumpy at about 14 km/h (1.2 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.7 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as asphalt. There were two bumps around the 9.4 and 9.9 km marks. There was also probably a jolt around the 9.6 km mark. The other two stretches (930 m) ranged from mildly bumpy to very bumpy, with no bumps or jolts. School Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative: Here is your 12-minute, 8.2 km drive. On Harbour Way the ride was mildly bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump around the 1.6 km mark as you braked. Ashgrove Road (3.1–3.6 km) felt fairly uncomfortable. It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as sett. A jolt around the 3.3 km mark may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. On Ashgrove Road (4.0–5.7 km) the ride was rough. It was jarring in places. It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as asphalt. There were three hard bumps. Granary Lane was rougher than Ashgrove Road (4.0–5.7 km) and felt punishing. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump. Willow Drive felt very rough. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump as you braked. The other three stretches ranged from comfortable to fairly uncomfortable, with three lower-priority events. Easing off on Granary Lane next time should make for a gentler ride.

narrative: Your 5.7 km run took 15 minutes. Farm Track was the smoothest stretch and felt perfectly comfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.72 m/s². That is about the same as usual on this route. There was a hard bump around the 0.0 km mark. There may also have been a jolt around the 0.1 km mark. There was also likely a bump around the 1.3 km mark. Forest Road (520 m) felt very rough at about 14 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.1 m/s². That is about the same as usual on this route. There were two sharp bumps around the 1.8 and 1.9 km marks. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. School Lane was smoother than Forest Road and felt a little uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.98 m/s². There were three sharp bumps around the 3.0, 3.6 and 3.7 km marks. On Willow Drive the surface is badly broken up, and at about 24 km/h it felt extremely rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 11.2 m/s². That is rougher than usual on this route. There may have been a jolt around the 4.0 km mark. There was also possibly a bump around the 4.2 km mark. There was also a sharp bump around the 4.5 km mark. Quarry Lane (840 m) is in very poor condition and felt very bumpy. It runs near Primary School. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.3 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There were two sharp bumps around the 5.1 and 5.3 km marks. There may also have been a jolt around the 5.2 km mark. The other stretch (200 m) was rough, with no bumps or jolts. Willow Drive is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- Ashgrove Road (5.5–6.0 km), 530 m: ride very bumpy (1.7 m/s²); surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.7 m/s²; there was likely a bump around the 5.8 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 1.2 km: ride a little uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.

Trip report: 6.3 km drive, 12 minutes.
- Lantern Lane (0.0–0.6 km), 590 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.83 m/s²) at about 38 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; near Town Hall; there was a hard bump around the 0.1 km mark.

- Ferry Road (5.6–6.3 km), 700 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.80 m/s²) at about 32 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.4 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 6.1 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 6.3 km mark.

narrative: Your 5.6 km drive took 9 minutes. School Lane was the smoothest stretch and felt comfortable. It was jarring in places. There was a bump. Signal Way (2.4–2.7 km) was rougher than School Lane and felt extremely uncomfortable. It runs near Petrol Station. Two jolts may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. Willow Drive felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in good condition. It was jarring in places. There was a bump as you braked. There were also two bumps. The ride on Orchard Lane was bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump around the 3.9 km mark. There was also likely a jolt around the 4.2 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The other two stretches were slightly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on Signal Way (2.4–2.7 km) next time should make for a gentler ride.

- Action: flag Harbour Way (0.3–0.7 km) for a maintenance review.

- Action: flag Ridge Road (0.0–0.4 km) for a maintenance review.

- Station Street (3.9–6.3 km), 2.4 km: ride perfectly comfortable (0.13 m/s²) at about 57 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.24 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 5.1 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 5.4 km mark.
- Elm Avenue (6.6–8.8 km), 2.2 km: ride perfectly comfortable (0.10 m/s²) at about 72 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.19 m/s²; the map lists it as unpaved, but it rides like asphalt; there was probably a jolt around the 7.0 km mark; there was a bump around the 8.2 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 340 m: ride calm; no bumps or jolts.

narrative:
Trip report: 6.4 km drive, 13 minutes.
- Park Avenue (0.0–1.7 km), 1.7 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.72 m/s²) at about 39 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; near City Library; there was a sharp bump around the 0.8 km mark.
- Garden Row (1.7–2.6 km), 930 m: ride uncomfortable (1.1 m/s²) at about 25 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.5 m/s²; there was likely a bump around the 2.2 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 2.6 km mark.
- Garden Row (2.6–3.3 km), 670 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.61 m/s²) at about 43 km/h; surface in good condition; there was probably a swerve around the 2.7 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there was probably a jolt around the 3.1 km mark.
- Hill Road (3.3–4.8 km), 1.5 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.85 m/s²) at about 35 km/h; surface in fair condition; there was likely a jolt around the 3.9 km mark.
- Linden Avenue (4.8–6.4 km), 1.6 km: ride very bumpy (1.5 m/s²) at about 20 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.5 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 5.6 km mark; there were two bumps around the 6.2 and 6.3 km marks.
- Action: flag Park Avenue (0.0–1.7 km) for a maintenance review.

- Park Avenue (2.3–3.3 km), 990 m: ride perfectly comfortable (0.12 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.30 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 2.4 km mark.

- Abbey Street (6.0–6.4 km), 410 m: ride rough (1.2 m/s²) at about 62 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.1 m/s²; near Post Office; there were two sharp bumps around the 6.1 and 6.2 km marks; there was probably a swerve around the 6.4 km mark, likely around an obstacle.
- Victoria Road (6.4–7.2 km), 830 m: ride very rough (1.5 m/s²) at about 46 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.3 m/s²; near Post Office; there was a hard bump around the 6.4 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 720 m: ride comfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Brook Lane (1.4–2.3 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 9.2 km drive, 18 minutes.
- Castle Street (1.8–4.2 km), 2.4 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.67 m/s²) at about 35 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; the same as usual; there may have been a jolt around the 3.4 km mark; there was possibly a bump around the 3.8 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 4.0 km mark.
- Castle Street (4.2–4.5 km), 280 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.65 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; near Level Crossing; rougher than usual; there was a hard bump around the 4.3 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Church Lane (4.5–6.2 km), 1.8 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.37 m/s²) at about 18 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.69 m/s²; near Level Crossing; there was probably a bump around the 4.8 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 5.4 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Pottery Lane (6.2–8.3 km), 2.1 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.55 m/s²) at about 40 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.90 m/s²; smoother than usual; there was a bump around the 6.4 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 7.0 km mark.
- Harbour Way (8.3–9.2 km), 800 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.80 m/s²) at about 21 km/h; surface in poor condition; rougher than usual; there was possibly a bump around the 8.8 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.8 km: ride calm to fairly uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Castle Street (1.8–4.2 km) for a maintenance review.

The roughest stretch was Beacon Way, which felt very uncomfortable. There may have been two bumps around the 7.9 and 8.4 km marks. The other three stretches (3.4 km) ranged from calm to fairly bumpy, with two lower-priority events. Kings Road (0.0–0.6 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- Abbey Street (0.0–1.0 km), 990 m: ride uncomfortable (1.1 m/s²) at about 67 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.9 m/s²; the map lists it as gravel, but it rides like asphalt; there may have been two jolts around the 0.2 and 0.7 km marks; there was a hard bump around the 0.4 km mark.
- Abbey Street (1.0–2.7 km), 1.7 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.58 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 2.0 and 2.6 km marks.
- Elm Avenue (3.2–3.7 km), 510 m: ride rough (0.95 m/s²) at about 26 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.5 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 3.2 km mark.
- Kings Road (3.7–6.1 km), 2.4 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.64 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 4.0 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 5.0 km mark.
- Signal Way (6.1–6.4 km), 330 m: ride very bumpy (1.5 m/s²); surface in poor condition; the map lists it as paving stones, but it rides like asphalt.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.2 km: ride comfortable to very uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Abbey Street (0.0–1.0 km) for a maintenance review.

There was a hard bump around the 0.9 km mark. On Mill Road the surface is in poor condition, and at about 29 km/h it felt rough (1.3 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.4 m/s². There was a bump. There may also have been a jolt. Meadow Way is in good condition and felt slightly uncomfortable at about 66 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.3 m/s². There were three sharp bumps. Riverside Drive (3.2–5.2 km) felt a little uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 61 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in excellent condition (0.32 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.1 m/s². There may have been a bump around the 3.3 km mark. There was also likely a bump around the 3.6 km mark. There may also have been a swerve around the 5.1 km mark, possibly around an obstacle. North Ring is badly broken up and felt extremely rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 9.3 m/s². There were three hard bumps around the 5.4, 5.6 and 6.0 km marks. The other three stretches (1.4 km) ranged from calm to uncomfortable, with one lower-priority event. Hill Road is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- Weavers Way (1.8–2.1 km), 320 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.79 m/s²) at about 29 km/h; surface in fair condition; the map lists it as compacted, but it rides like cobblestones; near Water Tower.
- Orchard Lane (2.1–3.8 km), 1.7 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.52 m/s²) at about 55 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.6 m/s²; near Water Tower; there were two bumps around the 2.2 and 3.7 km marks; there may have been a jolt around the 3.5 km mark.
- Orchard Lane (3.8–5.3 km), 1.5 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.64 m/s²) at about 64 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.4 m/s²; there was a bump around the 3.9 km mark; there may have been a swerve around the 4.6 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- Willow Drive (5.3–7.4 km), 2.1 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.54 m/s²) at about 72 km/h; surface in good condition; near Primary School; there was likely a jolt around the 6.6 km mark.

The roughest stretch was Orchard Lane, which felt extremely uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 6.8 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 0.5 km mark. Kings Road (1.0–1.8 km) is in fair condition and felt fairly uncomfortable at about 30 km/h (0.77 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.5 m/s². There were two sharp bumps around the 1.0 and 1.5 km marks. Elm Avenue (760 m) is in good condition and felt a little uncomfortable (0.51 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.98 m/s². There were three bumps around the 5.6, 5.9 and 5.9 km marks. On Pottery Lane the surface is in poor condition, and at about 54 km/h it felt uncomfortable (1.4 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.6 m/s². That is rougher than usual on this route. There were two bumps around the 6.2 and 6.3 km marks. The other two stretches (3.5 km) ranged from comfortable to fairly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Orchard Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- The remaining stretch, 820 m: ride calm; two lower-priority events.

narrative:
Trip report: 5.7 km drive, 10 minutes.
- School Lane (0.8–2.5 km), 1.8 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.51 m/s²) at about 39 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.85 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 2.3 km mark.
- School Lane (2.5–3.2 km), 670 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.81 m/s²); surface in poor condition; there was likely a jolt around the 3.1 km mark.
- Harbour Way (3.2–3.7 km), 520 m: ride mildly bumpy (0.50 m/s²) at about 36 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; near Swimming Pool; there was probably a bump around the 3.4 km mark.
- Pottery Lane (3.7–4.2 km), 470 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.57 m/s²) at about 40 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.6 m/s²; the map lists it as unpaved, but it rides like cobblestones; near Swimming Pool; there was a hard bump around the 4.1 km mark.
- Church Lane (4.6–5.0 km), 380 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.64 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; near Water Tower; there were two bumps around the 4.7 and 4.9 km marks; there may have been a swerve around the 4.8 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- The remaining three stretches, 1.9 km: ride calm to fairly uncomfortable; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag School Lane (0.8–2.5 km) for a maintenance review.

Beacon Way felt noticeably bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in good condition. It was jarring in places. There were two bumps. The stretch from 1.5 to 2.6 km was rougher than Beacon Way and felt very rough. It was jarring in places. There were three bumps. The map has no street name for it. Gentler braking and a slower pace on Weavers Way would help most.

narrative:
Trip report: 5.7 km drive, 7 minutes.
- Ridge Road (0.0–0.3 km), 310 m: ride punishing (3.3 m/s²) at about 34 km/h; surface badly broken up; smoother than usual.
- Ridge Road (1.4–3.9 km), 2.5 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.65 m/s²) at about 74 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; the map lists it as sett, but it rides like asphalt; near General Hospital; rougher than usual; there were probably two bumps around the 2.4 and 3.8 km marks; there was a bump around the 3.2 km mark.
- Kings Road (4.2–5.7 km), 1.5 km: ride very uncomfortable (1.5 m/s²) at about 32 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.8 m/s²; near Primary School; there were likely two bumps around the 4.2 and 4.8 km marks; there was a bump around the 4.5 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.4 km: ride mildly bumpy to bumpy; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Ridge Road (0.0–0.3 km) for a maintenance review.

Granary Lane was smoother than Mill Road and felt a little uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There was probably a bump. A jolt may have come from pulling away rather than from the road. - Park Avenue (6.6–8.8 km), 2.3 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.37 m/s²) at about 64 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.63 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 6.7 and 8.2 km marks.
- Canal Road (8.8–9.3 km), 440 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.74 m/s²) at about 31 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; there was a bump around the 9.2 km mark.
- Ferry Road (9.3–9.8 km), 560 m: ride very rough (2.1 m/s²); surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 7.3 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 9.8 km mark.
- The remaining three stretches, 1.9 km: ride a little uncomfortable to rough; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag School Lane (0.0–2.2 km) for a maintenance review.

Copper Street (4.2–5.6 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.64 m/s². There was a sharp bump. The roughest stretch was Ashgrove Road (510 m), which felt uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.4 m/s². It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as sett. There was a sharp bump around the 1.8 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. Pottery Lane is in fair condition and felt fairly uncomfortable at about 36 km/h (0.75 m/s² weighted). It runs near City Library. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.8 m/s². There were two bumps around the 2.7 and 3.0 km marks. Weavers Way is in poor condition and felt rough at about 60 km/h. It runs near Old Mill. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.5 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There may have been a swerve around the 5.5 km mark, possibly around an obstacle. There was also possibly a jolt around the 5.6 km mark. There was also likely a bump around the 5.6 km mark. On Canal Road (5.8–7.1 km) the surface is in poor condition, and overall it felt uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.5 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There was a sharp bump around the 6.7 km mark. Canal Road (7.1–8.1 km) was smoother than Canal Road (5.8–7.1 km) and felt fairly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.1 m/s². There were three hard bumps. Ashgrove Road is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 8.2 km drive, 11 minutes.
- Church Lane (0.0–1.5 km), 1.5 km: ride bumpy (1.4 m/s²) at about 65 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.4 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 0.6 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 0.8 km mark; there was likely a bump around the 1.4 km mark.
- Quarry Lane (1.5–3.2 km), 1.7 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.76 m/s²) at about 58 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.8 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like cobblestones; there was a hard bump around the 2.7 km mark.
- Canal Road (3.2–3.8 km), 600 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.80 m/s²) at about 24 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.7 m/s²; the map lists it as unpaved, but it rides like asphalt; there was probably a bump around the 3.3 km mark.
- Factory Road (4.3–4.6 km), 300 m: ride bumpy (0.92 m/s²) at about 17 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there were two sharp bumps around the 4.3 and 4.5 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Park Avenue (4.6–6.6 km), 2.0 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.43 m/s²) at about 42 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.4 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; near Petrol Station; there was likely a bump around the 5.9 km mark.
- Harvest Lane (6.6–8.1 km), 1.4 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.63 m/s²) at about 56 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; near Level Crossing; there was a sharp bump around the 7.2 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 700 m: ride perfectly comfortable to uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Church Lane (0.0–1.5 km) for a maintenance review.

There was a sharp bump around the 4.0 km mark. There may also have been a jolt around the 4.3 km mark. On Willow Drive (4.5–6.2 km) the surface is in excellent condition, and overall it felt a little uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.86 m/s². There was likely a bump. Willow Drive (6.2–7.8 km) is in fair condition and felt fairly uncomfortable at about 50 km/h. There was likely a jolt around the 7.2 km mark. narrative: Your 5.5 km run took 11 minutes. Ashgrove Road felt uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 65 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in fair condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.1 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 1.4 km mark. Quarry Lane (1.5–2.0 km) was rougher than Ashgrove Road and felt extremely uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 9.1 m/s². There may have been a jolt around the 1.7 km mark. There was also a sharp bump around the 1.9 km mark. On Signal Way the ride was fairly uncomfortable at about 10 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.7 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as paving stones. There was a sharp bump around the 2.8 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. On Pottery Lane (760 m) the surface is in very poor condition, and at about 37 km/h it felt very uncomfortable. It runs near Swimming Pool. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 7.6 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 4.1 km mark. The other three stretches (1.9 km) ranged from a little uncomfortable to very bumpy, with no bumps or jolts. Quarry Lane (1.5–2.0 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- The remaining four stretches, 2.8 km: ride calm to noticeably bumpy; two lower-priority events.

- Action: flag Ashgrove Road (0.0–1.8 km) for a maintenance review.

Ridge Road (4.6–6.1 km) felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 69 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition (0.60 m/s² weighted). It runs near Swimming Pool. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.2 m/s². There were two bumps around the 5.8 and 6.0 km marks. Pottery Lane (6.8–8.2 km) felt a little uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 52 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in excellent condition (0.34 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.91 m/s². There was possibly a bump around the 6.9 km mark. There was also a sharp bump around the 7.7 km mark. On Ashgrove Road the surface is in poor condition, and at about 23 km/h it felt uncomfortable. There was probably a jolt around the 8.7 km mark. The other two stretches (910 m) ranged from calm to slightly uncomfortable, with three lower-priority events. Garden Row is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 8.7 km drive, 24 minutes.
- Station Street (0.0–1.3 km), 1.3 km: ride calm (0.11 m/s²) at about 72 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.23 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 0.2 km mark; there was likely a bump around the 1.2 km mark.
- Orchard Lane (1.7–2.4 km), 660 m: ride rough (1.1 m/s²) at about 43 km/h; surface in poor condition; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like cobblestones.
- Riverside Drive (2.4–4.1 km), 1.8 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.32 m/s²) at about 30 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; there was a bump around the 3.2 km mark.
- Riverside Drive (4.1–5.4 km), 1.2 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.40 m/s²) at about 78 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 4.3 km mark.
- Canal Road (5.4–6.9 km), 1.5 km: ride bumpy (1.4 m/s²) at about 18 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.2 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 5.4 and 5.5 km marks.
- Ferry Road (6.9–8.7 km), 1.8 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.66 m/s²) at about 10 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there was a bump around the 8.0 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- The remaining stretch, 460 m: ride noticeably bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Station Street (0.0–1.3 km) for a maintenance review.

Trip report: 9.1 km drive, 11 minutes.
- Meadow Way (0.0–1.9 km), 1.9 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.51 m/s²) at about 79 km/h; surface in good condition; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; there was possibly a jolt around the 0.9 km mark.
- Chapel Street (1.9–3.5 km), 1.6 km: ride perfectly comfortable (0.23 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.57 m/s²; near Market Hall; there were two hard bumps around the 2.2 and 3.3 km marks; there was possibly a jolt around the 2.7 km mark.
- Victoria Road (3.5–4.2 km), 680 m: ride mildly bumpy (0.34 m/s²) at about 42 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.85 m/s²; near Retail Park; there was possibly a jolt around the 3.8 km mark; there were two hard bumps around the 3.9 and 4.1 km marks.
- Ridge Road (6.0–6.6 km), 570 m: ride calm (0.19 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.63 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 6.3 km mark.
- Lantern Lane (6.6–9.1 km), 2.5 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.41 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.77 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 6.7 km mark; there may have been a swerve around the 6.9 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.8 km: ride calm to a little uncomfortable; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Chapel Street (1.9–3.5 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 9.1 km drive, 20 minutes.
- Orchard Lane (0.0–1.6 km), 1.6 km: ride extremely uncomfortable (2.5 m/s²) at about 17 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 9.5 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 0.6 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 1.4 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Ashgrove Road (1.6–3.1 km), 1.5 km: ride bumpy (1.2 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.1 m/s²; there was a bump around the 2.7 km mark.
- Copper Street (3.1–3.8 km), 670 m: ride rough (0.92 m/s²) at about 45 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.8 m/s²; there were two hard bumps around the 3.2 and 3.2 km marks.
- Granary Lane (5.4–6.6 km), 1.2 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.77 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.8 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 6.4 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Abbey Street (6.6–7.4 km), 810 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.67 m/s²) at about 56 km/h; surface in good condition; there may have been two jolts around the 6.8 and 6.9 km marks.
- The remaining three stretches, 3.3 km: ride perfectly comfortable to mildly bumpy; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Orchard Lane (0.0–1.6 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Here is your 13-minute, 7.8 km drive. Hill Road felt mildly bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in excellent condition. It runs near Petrol Station. It was jarring in places. It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as paving stones. There was a hard bump around the 1.2 km mark. A jolt around the 1.3 km mark may have come from pulling away rather than from the road. On Mill Road (3.1–3.6 km) the ride was very bumpy. It was jarring in places. There were two hard bumps. School Lane (3.6–5.3 km) felt rough mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in fair condition. It was jarring in places. There were two bumps. There was also possibly a bump. School Lane (5.3–5.9 km) was rougher than School Lane (3.6–5.3 km) and felt very uncomfortable. It runs near Water Tower. It was jarring in places. There were two bumps. Orchard Lane was smoother than School Lane (5.3–5.9 km) and felt mildly bumpy. It runs near Water Tower. It was jarring in places. There were two bumps around the 6.0 and 7.3 km marks. There was a hard bump around the 1.8 km mark. Riverside Drive felt fairly bumpy, and the surface itself is in fair condition. It runs near Central Station. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump as you braked. The roughest stretch was Abbey Street, which felt rough. It was jarring in places. It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as gravel. There was likely a bump around the 3.1 km mark. There was also a sharp bump around the 3.2 km mark as you braked. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. Quarry Lane (3.3–3.6 km) was smoother than Abbey Street and felt fairly bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was probably a bump around the 3.4 km mark. On Quarry Lane (3.6–5.5 km) the ride was fairly bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump. There was also probably a jolt. The other stretch was perfectly comfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on Beacon Way next time should make for a gentler ride.

narrative:
Trip report: 5.5 km drive, 12 minutes.
- Station Street (0.0–0.6 km), 590 m: ride uncomfortable (0.91 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.8 m/s²; the map lists it as sett, but it rides like asphalt; there was a bump around the 0.1 km mark; there may have been a swerve around the 0.6 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- Ferry Road (0.6–1.9 km), 1.3 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.66 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.4 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 1.3 and 1.8 km marks; there was likely a bump around the 1.7 km mark.
- Ferry Road (1.9–2.5 km), 560 m: ride very uncomfortable (1.5 m/s²) at about 44 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 2.0 km mark.
- School Lane (2.5–3.9 km), 1.4 km: ride very rough (2.1 m/s²) at about 24 km/h; surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.2 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 3.1 and 3.6 km marks; there was likely a jolt around the 3.3 km mark.
- Meadow Way (3.9–4.5 km), 540 m: ride very bumpy (1.9 m/s²); surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.1 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 4.0 and 4.2 km marks.
- the stretch from 5.2 to 5.5 km, 340 m: ride very uncomfortable (1.8 m/s²) at about 28 km/h; surface in very poor condition; near Retail Park; no street name in the map.
- The remaining stretch, 700 m: ride very rough; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Station Street (0.0–0.6 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 4.7 km run took 7 minutes. The roughest stretch was Tannery Row, which felt very uncomfortable (1.4 m/s² weighted). It runs near Swimming Pool. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 5.1 m/s². There were possibly two jolts. There was also a sharp bump. Linden Avenue (1.8–3.8 km) felt noticeably bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 64 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.4 m/s². There were three hard bumps. On Copper Street the surface is in fair condition, and at about 26 km/h it felt fairly uncomfortable (0.80 m/s² weighted). It runs near General Hospital. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.9 m/s². That is rougher than usual on this route. There was a bump around the 4.5 km mark. The other stretch (530 m) was rough, with no bumps or jolts. Tannery Row is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

A jolt may have come from pulling away rather than from the road. There was also likely a bump. The map has no street name for it. On the stretch from 5.4 to 6.1 km the ride was very bumpy. Orchard Lane was smoother than the stretch from 5.4 to 6.1 km and felt slightly uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump. Forest Road was rougher than Orchard Lane and felt uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There was probably a bump. The other three stretches (4.5 km) were calm, with one lower-priority event.

narrative:
Trip report: 7.1 km drive, 11 minutes.
- Forest Road (0.0–1.5 km), 1.5 km: ride comfortable (0.28 m/s²) at about 66 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.48 m/s²; near Water Tower; there was a sharp bump around the 0.1 km mark.
- Tannery Row (1.5–1.7 km), 230 m: ride bumpy (1.2 m/s²) at about 44 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.1 m/s²; the map lists it as sett, but it rides like asphalt; near Water Tower; there were likely three bumps around the 1.5, 1.6 and 1.6 km marks.
- Linden Avenue (1.9–2.6 km), 620 m: ride uncomfortable (1.4 m/s²) at about 76 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.1 m/s²; near Market Hall; there was probably a jolt around the 2.0 km mark; there was a bump around the 2.3 km mark.
- Orchard Lane (2.6–3.3 km), 700 m: ride rough (1.2 m/s²) at about 39 km/h; surface in poor condition.
- Elm Avenue (3.3–5.0 km), 1.7 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.58 m/s²) at about 34 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.4 m/s²; there was a bump around the 4.4 km mark.
- Harvest Lane (5.0–7.1 km), 2.1 km: ride rough (1.2 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.8 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 5.4 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 6.5 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 250 m: ride noticeably bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Forest Road (0.0–1.5 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 5.8 km run took 10 minutes. The roughest stretch was Church Lane, which felt extremely uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 5.4 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There were two bumps around the 1.6 and 1.9 km marks. Orchard Lane (460 m) was smoother than Church Lane and felt noticeably bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.8 m/s². There was a bump around the 2.2 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. On Pottery Lane the surface is in poor condition, and at about 35 km/h it felt bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.1 m/s². There were two bumps. There was also possibly a bump. Ashgrove Road felt very rough mostly because of speed: at about 51 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in poor condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.1 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There were two sharp bumps. There was also likely a jolt. Station Street is in poor condition and felt bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.3 m/s². It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as sett. There was probably a bump around the 5.4 km mark. The other stretch (1.4 km) was comfortable, with two lower-priority events. Church Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 10.1 km drive, 16 minutes.
- Ridge Road (0.0–2.0 km), 2.0 km: ride comfortable (0.13 m/s²) at about 48 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.42 m/s²; there was possibly a bump around the 0.1 km mark; there was a bump around the 0.2 km mark.
- Mill Road (2.0–4.2 km), 2.3 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.67 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; smoother than usual; there were two hard bumps around the 2.1 and 3.4 km marks.
- Canal Road (5.9–6.3 km), 320 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.86 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; rougher than usual; there was a hard bump around the 6.0 km mark; there may have been a bump around the 6.2 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Elm Avenue (6.3–6.5 km), 270 m: ride uncomfortable (0.99 m/s²) at about 10 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.8 m/s²; there was a bump around the 6.3 km mark; there was probably a swerve around the 6.5 km mark, likely around an obstacle; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Elm Avenue (6.5–8.9 km), 2.4 km: ride bumpy (1.1 m/s²); surface in poor condition; smoother than usual; there may have been a bump around the 6.6 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 6.8 km mark; there was probably a jolt around the 6.9 km mark.
- Elm Avenue (8.9–10.1 km), 1.2 km: ride rough (1.1 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.2 m/s²; rougher than usual; there was a hard bump around the 9.0 km mark; there were likely two bumps around the 9.2 and 9.8 km marks.
- The remaining stretch, 1.7 km: ride calm; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Ridge Road (0.0–2.0 km) for a maintenance review.

Trip report: 11.2 km drive, 17 minutes.
- Forest Road (0.0–1.1 km), 1.1 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.86 m/s²) at about 15 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.0 m/s²; the map lists it as paving stones, but it rides like an unpaved road; near Market Hall; there were two sharp bumps around the 0.3 and 0.8 km marks; there was probably a jolt around the 0.5 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Forest Road (1.1–2.2 km), 1.2 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.44 m/s²) at about 31 km/h; surface in good condition; there may have been a swerve around the 1.3 km mark, possibly around an obstacle; there was probably a swerve around the 2.1 km mark, likely around an obstacle.
- Weavers Way (2.2–4.2 km), 2.0 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.68 m/s²) at about 75 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; there were three hard bumps around the 2.7, 4.0 and 4.2 km marks; 73-second GPS gap.
- Church Lane (5.6–7.9 km), 2.3 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.41 m/s²) at about 65 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.80 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; near Swimming Pool; there were possibly two jolts around the 6.1 and 7.2 km marks; there was likely a bump around the 6.4 km mark.
- Lantern Lane (7.9–8.6 km), 660 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.69 m/s²) at about 19 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; there may have been a jolt around the 8.0 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 8.2 km mark; there was probably a jolt around the 8.4 km mark.
- Signal Way (9.6–11.2 km), 1.7 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.41 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; there was a bump around the 10.7 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 11.1 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.4 km: ride perfectly comfortable; two lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Forest Road (0.0–1.1 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Here is your 10-minute, 6.3 km drive. The roughest stretch was Willow Drive, which felt extremely uncomfortable. Market Street felt noticeably bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in good condition. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump. A jolt probably came from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. Mill Road (3.1–4.2 km) felt fairly bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was likely a bump around the 3.6 km mark as you braked. There was also probably a swerve around the 4.0 km mark, likely around an obstacle. There was also a hard bump around the 4.1 km mark. Mill Road (4.2–5.7 km) was smoother than Mill Road (3.1–4.2 km) and felt comfortable. It runs near Level Crossing. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump around the 4.3 km mark. There was also probably a bump around the 4.5 km mark. The other three stretches ranged from calm to noticeably bumpy, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on Willow Drive next time should make for a gentler ride.

narrative:
Trip report: 7.0 km drive, 10 minutes.
- Forest Road (0.0–1.6 km), 1.6 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.82 m/s²) at about 55 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.5 m/s²; there were three hard bumps around the 0.2, 0.8 and 1.0 km marks.
- Farm Track (1.6–2.4 km), 830 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.48 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; the map lists it as gravel, but it rides like cobblestones; there may have been a bump around the 1.7 km mark; there was a bump around the 2.4 km mark.
- Farm Track (2.4–4.3 km), 1.9 km: ride perfectly comfortable (0.21 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.45 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 2.8 km mark.
- Granary Lane (4.3–4.8 km), 460 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.79 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; there was probably a swerve around the 4.4 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there was probably a bump around the 4.5 km mark.
- Granary Lane (4.8–6.0 km), 1.2 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.74 m/s²) at about 76 km/h; surface in good condition; there was likely a jolt around the 4.9 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 5.8 km mark.
- Abbey Street (6.9–7.0 km), 150 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.73 m/s²) at about 18 km/h; surface in fair condition.
- The remaining stretch, 930 m: ride calm; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Forest Road (0.0–1.6 km) for a maintenance review.

- Church Lane (9.4–10.6 km), 1.2 km: ride bumpy (1.2 m/s²) at about 65 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.9 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; there may have been two jolts around the 9.5 and 9.7 km marks; there was a hard bump around the 9.8 km mark.

- The remaining two stretches, 1.8 km: ride perfectly comfortable to slightly uncomfortable; two lower-priority events.

- Pottery Lane (0.0–1.2 km), 1.2 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.57 m/s²) at about 36 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; there was possibly a bump around the 0.7 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 1.0 km mark.
- Granary Lane (1.2–1.6 km), 430 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.66 m/s²) at about 63 km/h; surface in good condition.
- Granary Lane (1.6–2.9 km), 1.3 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.34 m/s²) at about 37 km/h; surface in good condition; the map lists it as gravel, but it rides like asphalt; there may have been a jolt around the 2.6 km mark.
- Granary Lane (2.9–4.1 km), 1.2 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.78 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.9 m/s²; there were possibly two jolts around the 3.1 and 3.4 km marks; there was a bump around the 3.5 km mark.
- Ferry Road (4.1–6.5 km), 2.4 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.46 m/s²) at about 37 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.94 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 5.2 km mark; there was likely a bump around the 5.5 km mark.
- Weavers Way (6.5–7.2 km), 690 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.76 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 6.6 and 7.0 km marks.
- The remaining stretch, 220 m: ride fairly bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Pottery Lane (0.0–1.2 km) for a maintenance review.

- Ferry Road (9.9–10.9 km), 1.1 km: ride bumpy (0.95 m/s²) at about 24 km/h; surface in poor condition; there were possibly two bumps around the 10.4 and 10.7 km marks.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.4 km: ride perfectly comfortable to a little uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.

narrative: Your 9.8 km drive took 16 minutes. Brook Lane felt bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in fair condition. It was jarring in places. There were three sharp bumps. On Tannery Row (2.6–3.5 km) the ride was fairly bumpy. It runs near Primary School. A jolt probably came from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. On Mill Road the ride was fairly uncomfortable, and the surface itself is in good condition. It runs near Sports Ground. It was jarring in places. There was a bump as you braked. On Victoria Road the ride was slightly uncomfortable. There was likely a jolt around the 5.6 km mark. A jolt around the 6.2 km mark probably came from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. Granary Lane (7.2–8.9 km) was rougher than Victoria Road and felt very bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was likely a bump as you braked. There was also a sharp bump. The ride on Granary Lane (8.9–9.8 km) was mildly bumpy. It was jarring in places. A jolt may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. There was also a sharp bump as you braked. There was also a hard bump. The other two stretches ranged from perfectly comfortable to mildly bumpy, with one lower-priority event. Easing off on Granary Lane (7.2–8.9 km) next time should make for a gentler ride.

On Pottery Lane (2.2 km) the surface is in fair condition, and at about 48 km/h it felt rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.1 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as asphalt. There were two sharp bumps around the 3.6 and 3.7 km marks. The other stretch (190 m) was extremely uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Pottery Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 7.9 km drive, 18 minutes.
- Weavers Way (0.0–1.4 km), 1.4 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.79 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.9 m/s²; there were two hard bumps around the 0.2 and 1.2 km marks; there was probably a bump around the 1.0 km mark.
- Riverside Drive (1.4–2.6 km), 1.3 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.69 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; there was probably a swerve around the 1.6 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there were two bumps around the 1.8 and 2.6 km marks.
- Meadow Way (2.6–3.8 km), 1.2 km: ride rough (1.2 m/s²) at about 39 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; the map lists it as sett, but it rides like asphalt; there were two bumps around the 2.7 and 3.3 km marks; there may have been a jolt around the 3.6 km mark.
- Chapel Street (3.8–4.8 km), 940 m: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.41 m/s²) at about 43 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 4.3 km mark.
- Chapel Street (4.8–5.9 km), 1.2 km: ride extremely uncomfortable (3.5 m/s²) at about 23 km/h; surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 11.4 m/s²; there were two sharp bumps around the 4.9 and 5.4 km marks; there was likely a jolt around the 5.0 km mark.
- Lantern Lane (5.9–7.3 km), 1.4 km: ride bumpy (1.2 m/s²) at about 20 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.6 m/s²; there were three sharp bumps around the 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 km marks.
- The remaining stretch, 550 m: ride very bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Weavers Way (0.0–1.4 km) for a maintenance review.

Trip report: 12.7 km drive, 20 minutes.
- Linden Avenue (0.0–1.9 km), 1.9 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.64 m/s²) at about 52 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 0.6 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 1.3 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 1.4 km mark.
- Copper Street (1.9–4.3 km), 2.4 km: ride perfectly comfortable (0.23 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.47 m/s²; near Market Hall; there was a sharp bump around the 2.7 km mark; there was likely a jolt around the 3.5 km mark.
- Beacon Way (4.3–5.9 km), 1.6 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.80 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 5.5 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 5.7 km mark.
- Ridge Road (5.9–6.8 km), 930 m: ride mildly bumpy (0.32 m/s²) at about 12 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.68 m/s²; there were two hard bumps around the 6.7 and 6.8 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- the stretch from 8.3 to 10.1 km, 1.8 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.34 m/s²) at about 68 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.75 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 8.4 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 8.6 km mark; no street name in the map.
- Harbour Way (10.3–12.7 km), 2.5 km: ride calm (0.13 m/s²) at about 58 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.29 m/s²; there may have been a jolt around the 11.4 km mark; there was probably a jolt around the 12.1 km mark; there was a bump around the 12.5 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.6 km: ride calm to noticeably bumpy; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Linden Avenue (0.0–1.9 km) for a maintenance review.

Weavers Way (5.4–7.7 km) felt uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 75 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in fair condition. There was also a hard bump around the 6.7 km mark. On Orchard Lane the surface is in fair condition, and at about 30 km/h it felt rough. It runs near Bus Depot. There may have been a bump. The other stretch (2.2 km) was calm, with one lower-priority event. Tannery Row is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 8.9 km drive, 12 minutes.
- Farm Track (0.0–0.4 km), 430 m: ride mildly bumpy (0.39 m/s²) at about 40 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; rougher than usual; there was a sharp bump around the 0.3 km mark.
- Pottery Lane (1.3–3.4 km), 2.1 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.41 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; near City Library; there were two sharp bumps around the 2.0 and 2.9 km marks.
- Weavers Way (3.7–4.2 km), 460 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.86 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there was a bump around the 3.7 km mark.
- School Lane (4.2–5.7 km), 1.5 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.37 m/s²); surface in good condition; smoother than usual; there was likely a jolt around the 5.0 km mark.
- School Lane (5.7–7.2 km), 1.5 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.69 m/s²) at about 68 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; near Primary School; smoother than usual; there were three bumps around the 6.2, 6.4 and 7.0 km marks.
- Ferry Road (7.2–8.9 km), 1.8 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.73 m/s²) at about 25 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; near Primary School; smoother than usual; there were three sharp bumps around the 7.2, 7.5 and 8.7 km marks.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.2 km: ride fairly uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Farm Track (0.0–0.4 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 10.7 km drive, 13 minutes.
- Willow Drive (0.0–2.4 km), 2.4 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.70 m/s²) at about 59 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there were two hard bumps around the 0.1 and 1.0 km marks.
- Willow Drive (2.4–4.9 km), 2.5 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.38 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.92 m/s²; there was probably a jolt around the 3.1 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 4.1 km mark.
- Copper Street (4.9–5.5 km), 530 m: ride uncomfortable (1.2 m/s²) at about 13 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.4 m/s²; near Level Crossing; there were two sharp bumps around the 5.1 and 5.2 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- School Lane (5.5–6.2 km), 790 m: ride extremely rough (2.3 m/s²) at about 31 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.8 m/s²; near Post Office; there was probably a bump around the 6.0 km mark; there were two sharp bumps around the 6.1 and 6.2 km marks.
- Harbour Way (6.2–8.6 km), 2.3 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.71 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; there may have been a jolt around the 6.5 km mark; there was likely a jolt around the 8.2 km mark; there was a bump around the 8.4 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.1 km: ride slightly uncomfortable to punishing; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Willow Drive (0.0–2.4 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 7.3 km drive, 12 minutes.
- Copper Street (0.0–0.8 km), 830 m: ride perfectly comfortable (0.29 m/s²) at about 31 km/h; surface in excellent condition; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like cobblestones; the same as usual.
- Abbey Street (0.8–2.8 km), 1.9 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.75 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.7 m/s²; near Fire Station; rougher than usual; there was a bump around the 2.7 km mark.
- Victoria Road (2.8–3.0 km), 210 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.64 m/s²) at about 37 km/h; surface in good condition; the map lists it as compacted, but it rides like cobblestones; near Fire Station; smoother than usual; there may have been a bump around the 3.0 km mark.
- Victoria Road (3.0–3.5 km), 520 m: ride mildly bumpy (0.33 m/s²) at about 44 km/h; surface in excellent condition; near Fire Station; smoother than usual.
- Harvest Lane (3.9–6.1 km), 2.2 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.48 m/s²) at about 43 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.6 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 4.3 km mark; there were two sharp bumps around the 4.7 and 4.9 km marks.
- Harvest Lane (6.1–7.3 km), 1.1 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.73 m/s²) at about 23 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 6.2 and 6.3 km marks.
- The remaining stretch, 430 m: ride calm; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Abbey Street (0.8–2.8 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 13.8 km drive, 21 minutes.
- Elm Avenue (0.8–2.7 km), 1.9 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.43 m/s²) at about 75 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 1.4 and 1.7 km marks.
- Farm Track (4.8–6.7 km), 1.9 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.52 m/s²) at about 71 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.6 m/s²; there were three sharp bumps around the 5.2, 5.4 and 6.1 km marks.
- Harbour Way (6.7–9.1 km), 2.4 km: ride calm (0.26 m/s²) at about 57 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.88 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 8.9 km mark.
- Lantern Lane (9.1–11.2 km), 2.1 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.46 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.7 m/s²; there was probably a jolt around the 9.2 km mark; there was a bump around the 9.7 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 10.7 km mark.
- Tannery Row (11.2–12.0 km), 790 m: ride calm (0.12 m/s²) at about 55 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.37 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like cobblestones; there was a hard bump around the 11.5 km mark; 23-second GPS gap.
- Tannery Row (12.0–13.8 km), 1.8 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.45 m/s²) at about 28 km/h; surface in good condition; there was likely a jolt around the 12.5 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.9 km: ride comfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Elm Avenue (0.8–2.7 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 8.9 km run took 15 minutes. On Elm Avenue the surface is in fair condition, and overall it felt noticeably bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.7 m/s². There was probably a jolt. There was also a hard bump. Castle Street was smoother than Elm Avenue and felt a little uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.4 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as asphalt. There were two bumps. Station Street was rougher than Castle Street and felt rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.6 m/s². There were two bumps around the 3.3 and 3.7 km marks. There was also possibly a bump around the 3.5 km mark. On Kings Road the surface is in fair condition, and overall it felt fairly uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.7 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 4.1 km mark. There were also possibly two jolts around the 4.4 and 5.2 km marks. Hill Road felt uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.3 m/s². There was possibly a bump around the 5.6 km mark. There was also probably a bump around the 5.7 km mark. There was also a hard bump around the 6.3 km mark. The other stretch (2.5 km) was comfortable, with one lower-priority event. Station Street is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Weavers Way was smoother than Ferry Road (3.4–3.6 km) and felt noticeably bumpy (0.73 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.4 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 3.9 km mark. Harbour Way (4.7–5.8 km) was rougher than Weavers Way and felt bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.7 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as dirt. There were two bumps around the 4.8 and 5.0 km marks. The roughest stretch was Harbour Way (5.8–8.3 km), which felt rough. It runs near Central Station. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.8 m/s². That is rougher than usual on this route. There were probably two bumps around the 6.0 and 7.4 km marks. There was also a sharp bump around the 8.2 km mark. The other two stretches (2.5 km) ranged from comfortable to noticeably bumpy, with one lower-priority event. Ferry Road (3.4–3.6 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- Linden Avenue (1.5–3.1 km), 1.6 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.45 m/s²) at about 68 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.85 m/s²; near Primary School; there were two sharp bumps around the 1.7 and 2.7 km marks.
- the stretch from 3.1 to 5.2 km, 2.1 km: ride rough (1.3 m/s²) at about 66 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; near City Library; there was a sharp bump around the 4.9 km mark; no street name in the map.
- Church Lane (5.2–5.8 km), 690 m: ride comfortable (0.27 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.64 m/s²; near City Library; there was a sharp bump around the 5.7 km mark.
- Church Lane (5.8–6.2 km), 320 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.47 m/s²) at about 55 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.6 m/s²; the map lists it as paving stones, but it rides like asphalt; there was a bump around the 6.1 km mark.
- Ferry Road (6.2–8.4 km), 2.2 km: ride comfortable (0.23 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.76 m/s²; there was probably a swerve around the 7.0 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there was a sharp bump around the 8.2 km mark.
- Ashgrove Road (8.4–9.4 km), 990 m: ride rough (1.4 m/s²) at about 16 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.4 m/s²; near Water Tower; there were two sharp bumps around the 8.6 and 8.7 km marks; there was likely a bump around the 9.2 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Ashgrove Road (9.4–10.4 km), 1.0 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.88 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.6 m/s²; near Water Tower; there was a hard bump around the 9.9 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Action: flag Linden Avenue (0.0–1.5 km) for a maintenance review.

Farm Track (170 m) was rougher than Pottery Lane and felt very uncomfortable (1.5 m/s² weighted). It runs near Central Station. Canal Road (1.1–1.9 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative: Your 5.2 km run took 10 minutes. On Kings Road the ride was bumpy at about 18 km/h (0.97 m/s² weighted). It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as gravel. There may have been a bump. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The stretch from 0.3 to 1.7 km is in fair condition and felt noticeably bumpy at about 38 km/h (0.76 m/s² weighted). There was possibly a bump. The map has no street name for it. The roughest stretch was Harbour Way (3.5–4.0 km), which felt uncomfortable. The ride on Riverside Drive (340 m) was bumpy. Park Avenue (490 m) was smoother than Riverside Drive and felt fairly bumpy (0.57 m/s² weighted). It runs near General Hospital. There was possibly a bump around the 4.8 km mark. The other two stretches (2.2 km) ranged from calm to fairly bumpy, with no bumps or jolts. Kings Road is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 7.9 km drive, 15 minutes.
- Farm Track (0.9–2.7 km), 1.8 km: ride rough (0.95 m/s²) at about 23 km/h; surface in poor condition; near Swimming Pool; smoother than usual; there was possibly a jolt around the 1.6 km mark.
- Canal Road (2.7–2.9 km), 200 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.80 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.8 m/s²; near Retail Park; the same as usual; there was a bump around the 2.8 km mark.
- Canal Road (2.9–5.2 km), 2.3 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.77 m/s²) at about 46 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.4 m/s²; near Retail Park; there were likely two bumps around the 3.1 and 3.6 km marks.
- the stretch from 5.2 to 5.6 km, 450 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.76 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.7 m/s²; smoother than usual; there may have been a bump around the 5.2 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 5.5 km mark; no street name in the map.
- Weavers Way (5.6–7.2 km), 1.6 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.82 m/s²) at about 49 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.9 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 6.2 and 6.7 km marks.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.6 km: ride a little uncomfortable to fairly uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Canal Road (2.7–2.9 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 6.8 km drive, 11 minutes.
- Tannery Row (0.0–1.4 km), 1.4 km: ride bumpy (0.91 m/s²) at about 37 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 0.1 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 0.2 km mark; there may have been a bump around the 1.3 km mark.
- North Ring (1.4–3.6 km), 2.2 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.82 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.4 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 2.2 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 2.9 km mark.
- Elm Avenue (5.3–6.0 km), 700 m: ride rough (0.94 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; near Level Crossing; the same as usual; there was a sharp bump around the 5.5 km mark.
- Chapel Street (6.0–6.3 km), 310 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.60 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; near Town Hall; the same as usual; there was probably a bump around the 6.2 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.2 km: ride comfortable to rough; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Tannery Row (0.0–1.4 km) for a maintenance review.

There were two hard bumps. On Ridge Road (2.7–4.3 km) the surface is in good condition, and at about 22 km/h it felt mildly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.3 m/s². There were two hard bumps. On Ridge Road (4.3–6.5 km) the surface is in good condition, and overall it felt mildly bumpy (0.40 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.3 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 5.3 km mark. There was also a bump around the 6.1 km mark. Ridge Road (6.5–7.7 km) felt fairly uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 66 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.9 m/s². There was possibly a jolt. There was also a bump. There was also probably a jolt. narrative:
Trip report: 13.3 km drive, 16 minutes.
Without a gyroscope, steering events could not be checked.
- the stretch from 2.4 to 4.2 km, 1.8 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.32 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; the map lists it as paving stones, but it rides like asphalt; there may have been a jolt around the 3.6 km mark; no street name in the map.
- Hill Road (4.2–5.6 km), 1.4 km: ride comfortable (0.20 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.58 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like cobblestones; near Retail Park; there may have been a jolt around the 4.3 km mark; there was likely a bump around the 5.3 km mark.
- Mill Road (5.6–6.5 km), 850 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.55 m/s²) at about 54 km/h; surface in good condition.
- Canal Road (8.9–9.3 km), 430 m: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.45 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.4 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 9.0 km mark.
- Orchard Lane (11.7–13.3 km), 1.6 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.35 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.71 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 12.7 km mark.
- The remaining three stretches, 7.2 km: ride perfectly comfortable; five lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Hill Road (4.2–5.6 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 9.3 km drive, 16 minutes.
- Ferry Road (0.0–0.8 km), 830 m: ride mildly bumpy (0.44 m/s²); surface in good condition; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like cobblestones.
- Hill Road (2.7–5.0 km), 2.3 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.70 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.6 m/s²; near Sports Ground; smoother than usual; there were two sharp bumps around the 3.0 and 3.2 km marks.
- Weavers Way (5.0–6.3 km), 1.3 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.83 m/s²); smoother than usual; there may have been a swerve around the 5.2 km mark, possibly around an obstacle; there were possibly two jolts around the 5.5 and 6.0 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Castle Street (6.3–6.8 km), 510 m: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.38 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; the map lists it as unpaved, but it rides like cobblestones; there was a sharp bump around the 6.6 km mark.
- School Lane (6.8–7.2 km), 430 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.71 m/s²) at about 37 km/h; surface in fair condition; rougher than usual; there may have been a bump around the 6.9 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 7.0 km mark.
- Church Lane (7.2–9.0 km), 1.8 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.87 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.8 m/s²; the map lists it as unpaved, but it rides like cobblestones; rougher than usual; there were three sharp bumps around the 8.0, 8.6 and 8.8 km marks.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.2 km: ride calm to a little uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Hill Road (2.7–5.0 km) for a maintenance review.

Trip report: 9.3 km drive, 16 minutes.
- Ridge Road (0.0–0.8 km), 780 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.60 m/s²); surface in fair condition; there was probably a jolt around the 0.8 km mark.
- Mill Road (0.8–2.3 km), 1.5 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.38 m/s²) at about 43 km/h; surface in good condition; there may have been a jolt around the 1.4 km mark; there may have been a bump around the 1.5 km mark.
- Abbey Street (2.3–3.7 km), 1.4 km: ride perfectly comfortable (0.30 m/s²) at about 33 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.65 m/s²; the same as usual; there may have been a jolt around the 2.6 km mark; there was a bump around the 3.5 km mark.
- the stretch from 3.7 to 4.5 km, 870 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.58 m/s²) at about 42 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there was likely a bump around the 3.9 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 4.0 km mark; no street name in the map.
- Station Street (5.6–6.4 km), 800 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.66 m/s²) at about 38 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.4 m/s²; rougher than usual; there was a sharp bump around the 6.0 km mark.
- Harbour Way (6.4–7.8 km), 1.3 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.40 m/s²) at about 26 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; the map lists it as sett, but it rides like asphalt; there were two hard bumps around the 6.6 and 7.4 km marks.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.6 km: ride comfortable to fairly uncomfortable; two lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Abbey Street (2.3–3.7 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 4.7 km run took 6 minutes. Willow Drive was the smoothest stretch and felt comfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.39 m/s². There may have been a bump around the 1.4 km mark. There was also probably a bump around the 2.0 km mark. There was also likely a jolt around the 2.2 km mark. Victoria Road (2.3–2.8 km) is in good condition and felt slightly uncomfortable at about 40 km/h (0.51 m/s² weighted). Victoria Road (2.8–3.0 km) was rougher than Victoria Road (2.3–2.8 km) and felt very rough (1.5 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.9 m/s². There were two hard bumps around the 2.8 and 3.0 km marks. On Elm Avenue the surface is in excellent condition, and overall it felt comfortable. There was possibly a jolt. Weavers Way was rougher than Elm Avenue and felt very rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.5 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 4.6 km mark. Victoria Road (2.8–3.0 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative: No map data was available, so places are given as distances. Without a gyroscope, steering events could not be checked. The roughest stretch was the stretch from 0.0 to 0.3 km, which felt very rough. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump. The ride on the stretch from 0.9 to 2.4 km was very uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. A jolt may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. There was also a bump as you braked. There was also a sharp bump. The stretch from 2.4 to 4.3 km was the smoothest stretch and felt mildly bumpy. It was jarring in places. There were two sharp bumps. There was also likely a bump. On the stretch from 4.3 to 6.2 km the ride was noticeably bumpy. It was jarring in places. A jolt probably came from pulling away rather than from the road. There was also a sharp bump. The stretch from 7.0 to 8.0 km felt fairly uncomfortable mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in good condition. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump. The stretch from 8.0 to 9.7 km felt bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in fair condition. It was jarring in places. There were two bumps. There was also a sharp bump as you braked. The other two stretches ranged from noticeably bumpy to very uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Gentler braking and a slower pace on the stretch from 0.0 to 0.3 km would help most.

It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.7 m/s². There were two sharp bumps. There was also likely a jolt. The other three stretches (2.4 km) ranged from comfortable to rough, with no bumps or jolts. Elm Avenue is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- Brook Lane (6.8–8.4 km), 1.6 km: ride bumpy (1.2 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.9 m/s²; there may have been a swerve around the 6.9 km mark, possibly around an obstacle; there was a sharp bump around the 8.0 km mark.
- North Ring (8.4–10.4 km), 2.0 km: ride bumpy (1.2 m/s²) at about 66 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.9 m/s²; near Swimming Pool; there was probably a swerve around the 9.4 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there was a sharp bump around the 10.3 km mark.
- North Ring (10.4–10.6 km), 170 m: ride uncomfortable (0.99 m/s²) at about 20 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.1 m/s²; the map lists it as cobblestone, but it rides like asphalt; there was a sharp bump around the 10.5 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.0 km: ride calm to fairly uncomfortable; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Factory Road (1.2–2.9 km) for a maintenance review.

Beacon Way is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.
