narrative: Your 9.0 km drive took 14 minutes. Castle Street (0.0–2.3 km) felt noticeably bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in good condition. It runs near Market Hall. It was jarring in places. There was probably a bump. There was also possibly a jolt. A jolt probably came from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. Castle Street (2.3–4.0 km) was rougher than Castle Street (0.0–2.3 km) and felt very rough. It was jarring in places. There was likely a bump around the 2.4 km mark. There were also two bumps around the 3.3 and 3.9 km marks. Park Avenue was smoother than Castle Street (2.3–4.0 km) and felt slightly uncomfortable. It runs near Town Hall. It was jarring in places. There were two sharp bumps. Beacon Way (4.8–6.0 km) felt a little uncomfortable mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in excellent condition. It runs near Town Hall. It was jarring in places. It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as asphalt. A jolt may have come from pulling away rather than from the road. There was also a hard bump. On Beacon Way (6.0–7.7 km) the ride was slightly uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There were two sharp bumps. There was also possibly a bump. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The other two stretches ranged from fairly bumpy to extremely rough, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on Castle Street (2.3–4.0 km) next time should make for a gentler ride.

Harbour Way (0.3–1.0 km) felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 55 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition (0.64 m/s² weighted). Market Street is in fair condition and felt fairly uncomfortable at about 29 km/h (0.77 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.7 m/s². There was a hard bump. There was also probably a bump. Meadow Way is in poor condition and felt rough at about 39 km/h. It runs near City Library. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.2 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as paving stones. There were two bumps around the 4.4 and 4.7 km marks. There was also possibly a jolt around the 4.6 km mark. North Ring was smoother than Meadow Way and felt fairly bumpy. It runs near Central Station. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.2 m/s². There was a hard bump. There was also likely a bump. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. Tannery Row is in good condition and felt mildly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.88 m/s². There were two hard bumps around the 5.9 and 6.1 km marks. The other two stretches (1.9 km) were slightly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Harbour Way (1.0–1.7 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 7.6 km drive, 15 minutes.
- Harvest Lane (0.0–2.2 km), 2.2 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.66 m/s²) at about 77 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; there may have been a jolt around the 1.1 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 1.5 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 1.9 km mark.
- the stretch from 2.2 to 4.0 km, 1.8 km: ride bumpy (1.3 m/s²) at about 15 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.8 m/s²; there was likely a bump around the 3.5 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low); no street name in the map.
- Lantern Lane (4.0–4.5 km), 580 m: ride very rough (1.7 m/s²) at about 15 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.9 m/s²; there were three sharp bumps around the 4.0, 4.2 and 4.3 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Lantern Lane (4.5–5.2 km), 650 m: ride calm (0.23 m/s²) at about 42 km/h; surface in excellent condition.
- Farm Track (5.2–6.1 km), 870 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.58 m/s²) at about 47 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; there may have been a jolt around the 5.2 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 5.3 km mark; there was a jolt around the 5.4 km mark.
- Church Lane (6.1–6.5 km), 410 m: ride uncomfortable (1.1 m/s²) at about 33 km/h; surface in poor condition.
- The remaining stretch, 1.1 km: ride perfectly comfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Harvest Lane (0.0–2.2 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 4.8 km run took 6 minutes. Ferry Road felt fairly uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 54 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition (0.60 m/s² weighted). That is smoother than usual on this route. Pottery Lane felt very bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 76 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in poor condition (1.9 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.7 m/s². There were two sharp bumps around the 1.8 and 3.1 km marks. Bridge Street was rougher than Pottery Lane and felt extremely rough (2.4 m/s² weighted). It runs near Old Mill. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 8.4 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as dirt. There was a hard bump around the 3.1 km mark. There may also have been two bumps around the 3.6 and 4.1 km marks. Lantern Lane (430 m) was smoother than Bridge Street and felt fairly uncomfortable. It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as asphalt. Bridge Street is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 8.8 km drive, 12 minutes.
- Factory Road (2.5–4.8 km), 2.3 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.43 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.4 m/s²; near Level Crossing; there were two bumps around the 4.1 and 4.6 km marks.
- Ferry Road (6.0–6.6 km), 630 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.36 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; there was likely a bump around the 6.5 km mark.
- Kings Road (7.0–8.8 km), 1.8 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.46 m/s²) at about 27 km/h; surface in good condition; there were probably two jolts around the 7.5 and 8.0 km marks.
- The remaining three stretches, 4.1 km: ride comfortable; two lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Factory Road (2.5–4.8 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 8.4 km drive, 20 minutes.
- Weavers Way (0.0–0.5 km), 520 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.77 m/s²) at about 55 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.7 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 0.5 km mark.
- Church Lane (0.5–2.7 km), 2.2 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.35 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; rougher than usual; there was probably a bump around the 0.9 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 2.1 km mark; there may have been a swerve around the 2.2 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- North Ring (2.7–3.8 km), 1.1 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.88 m/s²) at about 31 km/h; surface in fair condition; the same as usual; there was possibly a jolt around the 3.1 km mark.
- North Ring (3.8–5.2 km), 1.3 km: ride very rough (2.0 m/s²); surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 6.4 m/s²; there were three hard bumps around the 4.0, 4.4 and 4.8 km marks.
- Meadow Way (5.2–6.2 km), 990 m: ride uncomfortable (1.3 m/s²) at about 21 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.9 m/s²; there was a bump around the 5.8 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 6.1 km mark.
- Willow Drive (6.2–6.5 km), 370 m: ride very rough (1.7 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.1 m/s²; rougher than usual; there were two sharp bumps around the 6.2 and 6.4 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- The remaining two stretches, 1.9 km: ride perfectly comfortable to mildly bumpy; four lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Weavers Way (0.0–0.5 km) for a maintenance review.

Factory Road (3.0–4.5 km) felt bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 54 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in fair condition (0.94 m/s² weighted). That is rougher than usual on this route. There were two hard bumps around the 5.0 and 5.3 km marks. Copper Street is in fair condition and felt fairly bumpy at about 28 km/h (0.83 m/s² weighted). It runs near Sports Ground. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.2 m/s². That is rougher than usual on this route. There was a hard bump around the 6.5 km mark. narrative:
Trip report: 6.9 km drive, 11 minutes.
- Ridge Road (0.0–1.9 km), 1.9 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.64 m/s²) at about 26 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there may have been a swerve around the 0.2 km mark, possibly around an obstacle; there was a sharp bump around the 1.3 km mark.
- Kings Road (1.9–3.9 km), 1.9 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.50 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; near City Library; there were likely two bumps around the 2.2 and 3.4 km marks.
- North Ring (3.9–4.9 km), 1.0 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.70 m/s²) at about 64 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; the map lists it as cobblestone, but it rides like asphalt; there were two hard bumps around the 3.9 and 4.6 km marks; there was probably a swerve around the 4.5 km mark, likely around an obstacle.
- the stretch from 4.9 to 5.2 km, 330 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.57 m/s²) at about 16 km/h; there was likely a jolt around the 5.1 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low); no street name in the map.
- Signal Way (5.2–6.2 km), 930 m: ride mildly bumpy (0.33 m/s²) at about 35 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; there was a bump around the 5.9 km mark; there was probably a jolt around the 6.1 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 730 m: ride mildly bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Ridge Road (0.0–1.9 km) for a maintenance review.

- Castle Street (4.9–5.8 km), 910 m: ride very rough (1.5 m/s²) at about 29 km/h; surface in very poor condition; there may have been a bump around the 5.1 km mark.

Two jolts may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. North Ring was smoother than School Lane (3.9–5.6 km) and felt a little uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as sett. There was a sharp bump. Riverside Drive felt a little uncomfortable, and the surface itself is in good condition. It was jarring in places. A jolt around the 6.5 km mark may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. There was also probably a bump around the 6.8 km mark. Copper Street (7.9–9.5 km) felt slightly uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as compacted. There may have been a jolt around the 8.0 km mark. There was also a bump around the 8.9 km mark. Copper Street (9.5–10.5 km) felt mildly bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was likely a bump around the 9.7 km mark. A jolt around the 9.9 km mark may have come from pulling away rather than from the road. Easing off on School Lane (3.9–5.6 km) next time should make for a gentler ride.

Trip report: 10.2 km drive, 18 minutes.
- Tannery Row (0.0–1.6 km), 1.6 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.77 m/s²) at about 38 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 1.2 km mark.
- Tannery Row (1.6–2.5 km), 870 m: ride rough (1.1 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.5 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 2.0 km mark.

- Ridge Road (8.0–8.8 km), 790 m: ride bumpy (1.2 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.7 m/s²; there may have been a jolt around the 8.5 km mark; there were two hard bumps around the 8.6 and 8.7 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- The remaining two stretches, 2.0 km: ride perfectly comfortable; no bumps or jolts.

Copper Street (1.7–2.7 km) was rougher than the stretch from 1.4 to 1.7 km and felt fairly uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.7 m/s². It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as gravel. There were two bumps around the 1.9 and 2.1 km marks. There was also possibly a jolt around the 2.5 km mark. Copper Street (2.7–3.8 km) was smoother than Copper Street (1.7–2.7 km) and felt mildly bumpy (0.45 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.5 m/s². There was a bump. On School Lane (1.4 km) the surface is in good condition, and at about 77 km/h it felt fairly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.2 m/s². There was probably a swerve around the 4.8 km mark, likely around an obstacle. There was also a bump around the 5.0 km mark. Ashgrove Road was the smoothest stretch and felt perfectly comfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.57 m/s². There was a sharp bump. There was also likely a bump. There was also probably a jolt. Linden Avenue felt fairly uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 71 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.9 m/s². There were two sharp bumps around the 8.1 and 9.5 km marks. The other stretch (560 m) was a little uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts.

Victoria Road was smoother than Harvest Lane and felt perfectly comfortable (0.26 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.95 m/s². There were three sharp bumps around the 3.1, 3.2 and 3.8 km marks. Signal Way was rougher than Victoria Road and felt extremely rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 7.6 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 4.2 km mark. There were also two sharp bumps around the 4.5 and 5.0 km marks. Canal Road (5.1–7.1 km) felt rough mostly because of speed: at about 62 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in fair condition (0.97 m/s² weighted). Harbour Way is in good condition and felt a little uncomfortable (0.47 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.4 m/s². There was likely a bump. There was also a hard bump. There may also have been a swerve, possibly around an obstacle. The stretch from 9.0 to 9.8 km was rougher than Harbour Way and felt very bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.7 m/s². There may have been a jolt around the 9.3 km mark. There was also a hard bump around the 9.7 km mark. The map has no street name for it. The other stretch (160 m) was very bumpy, with no bumps or jolts. Signal Way is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Trip report: 7.8 km drive, 12 minutes.
- Signal Way (0.0–0.8 km), 770 m: ride very rough (1.6 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.1 m/s²; rougher than usual; there was a bump around the 0.2 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 0.6 km mark.
- Riverside Drive (1.9–3.7 km), 1.9 km: ride very uncomfortable (1.5 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.7 m/s²; near Retail Park; there were three hard bumps around the 2.4, 2.7 and 3.4 km marks.
- the stretch from 5.6 to 5.8 km, 260 m: ride very rough (2.2 m/s²) at about 28 km/h; surface in very poor condition; near Water Tower; rougher than usual; there was possibly a jolt around the 5.8 km mark; no street name in the map.
- Harvest Lane (6.1–7.8 km), 1.7 km: ride uncomfortable (1.4 m/s²) at about 36 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.0 m/s²; the map lists it as dirt, but it rides like asphalt; rougher than usual; there was a bump around the 6.4 km mark; there was probably a swerve around the 7.0 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there was possibly a bump around the 7.3 km mark.
- The remaining four stretches, 3.2 km: ride perfectly comfortable to a little uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Signal Way (0.0–0.8 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 10.8 km drive took 14 minutes. Willow Drive felt extremely uncomfortable, and the surface itself is badly broken up. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump around the 0.1 km mark. There was also possibly a jolt around the 0.6 km mark. On Harbour Way the ride was rough. It was jarring in places. There was a bump around the 4.3 km mark. A jolt around the 5.1 km mark may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. The stretch from 5.4 to 7.0 km was smoother than Harbour Way and felt slightly uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There was a bump around the 5.6 km mark as you braked. There was also a bump around the 5.8 km mark. The map has no street name for it. Hill Road was rougher than the stretch from 5.4 to 7.0 km and felt fairly uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump. Canal Road felt mildly bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in excellent condition. A jolt around the 9.9 km mark may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. The other three stretches ranged from perfectly comfortable to a little uncomfortable, with three lower-priority events. Easing off on Willow Drive next time should make for a gentler ride.

narrative: Your 8.1 km run took 13 minutes. Castle Street is in excellent condition and felt perfectly comfortable (0.25 m/s² weighted). It runs near Old Mill. There was probably a jolt around the 1.0 km mark. School Lane (1.6–3.2 km) is in good condition and felt a little uncomfortable at about 36 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.5 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There may have been a bump around the 2.3 km mark. There was also probably a jolt around the 2.4 km mark. There was also a hard bump around the 3.1 km mark. School Lane (3.2–4.7 km) is badly broken up and felt punishing at about 35 km/h. It runs near Fire Station. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 6.7 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There were likely two bumps around the 3.7 and 4.5 km marks. There may also have been a bump around the 4.6 km mark. On Weavers Way (5.2–6.0 km) the surface is in poor condition, and at about 24 km/h it felt uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.5 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There was a bump around the 5.3 km mark. Quarry Lane (6.0–7.7 km) is in good condition and felt fairly bumpy (0.58 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.7 m/s². That is smoother than usual on this route. There were three hard bumps. The other two stretches (870 m) were comfortable, with no bumps or jolts. School Lane (3.2–4.7 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Trip report: 7.1 km drive, 10 minutes.
- Forest Road (0.0–1.3 km), 1.3 km: ride uncomfortable (1.3 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.9 m/s²; near Market Hall; rougher than usual; there was probably a bump around the 0.7 km mark.
- Elm Avenue (1.6–2.3 km), 690 m: ride rough (1.1 m/s²) at about 69 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.2 m/s²; near Petrol Station; rougher than usual; there was a hard bump around the 2.3 km mark.
- Weavers Way (2.3–3.4 km), 1.1 km: ride uncomfortable (0.99 m/s²) at about 35 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.3 m/s²; there was a bump around the 2.4 km mark.
- Ashgrove Road (3.4–5.7 km), 2.3 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.55 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.89 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; rougher than usual; there may have been a jolt around the 4.2 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 5.4 km mark.
- The remaining three stretches, 1.8 km: ride comfortable to noticeably bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Forest Road (0.0–1.3 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 7.9 km run took 12 minutes. Station Street (0.0–2.1 km) felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 66 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition (0.69 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.5 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 1.4 km mark. Station Street (2.1–2.7 km) felt uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 58 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in fair condition. There may have been a jolt around the 2.5 km mark. Willow Drive (2.7–5.0 km) was smoother than Station Street (2.1–2.7 km) and felt a little uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.6 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 3.6 km mark. There was also possibly a jolt around the 4.8 km mark. Willow Drive (5.0–6.4 km) was rougher than Willow Drive (2.7–5.0 km) and felt very uncomfortable (1.5 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.0 m/s². There may have been a jolt. There was also a sharp bump. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The other stretch (1.6 km) was slightly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Willow Drive (5.0–6.4 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- Forest Road (1.3–2.4 km), 1.1 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.35 m/s²) at about 78 km/h; surface in excellent condition; near Old Mill.

- Castle Street (4.5–5.3 km), 800 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.50 m/s²); surface in good condition.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.8 km: ride perfectly comfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Park Avenue (0.5–1.3 km) for a maintenance review.

There were two sharp bumps around the 4.4 and 4.7 km marks. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The other three stretches (1.8 km) ranged from calm to slightly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts.

- Quarry Lane (5.2–5.7 km), 500 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.65 m/s²) at about 27 km/h; surface in fair condition; there was probably a jolt around the 5.5 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 1.4 km: ride perfectly comfortable; three lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Beacon Way (0.0–0.8 km) for a maintenance review.

It runs near Town Hall. It was jarring in places. There were two sharp bumps as you braked. The other two stretches ranged from fairly bumpy to very uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on Lantern Lane next time should make for a gentler ride.

narrative: Your 7.1 km run took 11 minutes. Garden Row is in excellent condition and felt slightly uncomfortable (0.37 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.3 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as asphalt. There were two bumps around the 0.1 and 1.2 km marks. There was also probably a jolt around the 0.2 km mark. Brook Lane (2.5–3.7 km) is in excellent condition and felt comfortable at about 35 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.88 m/s². There was a hard bump. There may also have been a jolt. Brook Lane (3.7–6.1 km) felt very bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 66 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in poor condition (1.4 m/s² weighted). It runs near Central Station. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.7 m/s². There was probably a swerve around the 3.8 km mark, likely around an obstacle. There was also a sharp bump around the 4.0 km mark. There may also have been a jolt around the 4.4 km mark. Forest Road was smoother than Brook Lane (3.7–6.1 km) and felt fairly uncomfortable. It runs near Sports Ground. There was likely a jolt around the 6.2 km mark. On Kings Road the surface is in poor condition, and overall it felt rough (1.1 m/s² weighted). It runs near Sports Ground. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.5 m/s². There were two bumps around the 7.0 and 7.0 km marks. The other two stretches (1.3 km) ranged from comfortable to very rough, with no bumps or jolts. Brook Lane (3.7–6.1 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Ferry Road (2.2–3.0 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 3.9 km drive, 9 minutes.
- Ferry Road (0.2–1.1 km), 880 m: ride very bumpy (1.5 m/s²) at about 38 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.8 m/s²; near Old Mill; there was probably a bump around the 1.0 km mark.
- Willow Drive (1.1–2.3 km), 1.2 km: ride bumpy (0.94 m/s²) at about 42 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.3 m/s²; there were two sharp bumps around the 1.2 and 1.5 km marks.
- Church Lane (2.3–3.6 km), 1.3 km: ride extremely uncomfortable (2.7 m/s²) at about 16 km/h; there was probably a swerve around the 2.5 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there may have been a jolt around the 3.4 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Abbey Street (3.6–3.9 km), 350 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.69 m/s²) at about 61 km/h; surface in good condition; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; there may have been a bump around the 3.6 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 240 m: ride very uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Ferry Road (0.2–1.1 km) for a maintenance review.

- Action: flag Park Avenue (0.0–1.9 km) for a maintenance review.

There was probably a bump around the 4.3 km mark. Signal Way felt noticeably bumpy at about 14 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.4 m/s². There were three hard bumps. Church Lane was rougher than Bridge Street and felt extremely rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 6.6 m/s². There were two bumps. The other two stretches (1.4 km) ranged from comfortable to bumpy, with one lower-priority event. Church Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

There were two hard bumps around the 0.7 and 0.9 km marks. On Farm Track (1.6–2.0 km) the surface is in good condition, and overall it felt fairly bumpy (0.61 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.5 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 2.0 km mark. On Abbey Street the surface is in good condition, and at about 69 km/h it felt slightly uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.3 m/s². There may have been two jolts around the 2.5 and 4.4 km marks. There was also likely a bump around the 3.7 km mark. The ride on Pottery Lane was slightly uncomfortable at about 15 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.5 m/s². There was likely a bump. There were also two bumps. Mill Road (6.5–8.5 km) is in excellent condition and felt mildly bumpy (0.33 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.0 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 7.0 km mark. There may also have been a jolt around the 7.2 km mark. There was also possibly a bump around the 7.5 km mark. The roughest stretch was Park Avenue, which felt fairly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.5 m/s². There was possibly a jolt around the 8.8 km mark. There was also a sharp bump around the 9.8 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The other two stretches (950 m) ranged from comfortable to noticeably bumpy, with no bumps or jolts.

- Orchard Lane (0.0–2.4 km), 2.4 km: ride calm (0.20 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.69 m/s²; there was likely a bump around the 1.5 km mark; there was a bump around the 2.3 km mark.

- Kings Road (4.4–5.2 km), 770 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.67 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.3 m/s²; near Retail Park; there was likely a bump around the 4.9 km mark.
- North Ring (5.2–6.5 km), 1.4 km: ride bumpy (1.1 m/s²) at about 34 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.0 m/s²; near Retail Park; there was a bump around the 6.0 km mark.
- Market Street (6.5–9.0 km), 2.4 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.50 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 6.8 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 8.3 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 490 m: ride very uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Orchard Lane (0.0–2.4 km) for a maintenance review.

It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.91 m/s². There were two bumps around the 5.7 and 6.1 km marks. There was also possibly a jolt around the 6.1 km mark. The other three stretches (1.9 km) were fairly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts.

Brook Lane (1.8–2.2 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Trip report: 7.8 km drive, 10 minutes.
- Lantern Lane (0.3–1.8 km), 1.5 km: ride punishing (3.3 m/s²) at about 41 km/h; surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 10.2 m/s²; there were two hard bumps around the 0.7 and 1.2 km marks; there may have been a jolt around the 1.6 km mark.
- Harbour Way (1.8–2.8 km), 1.0 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.57 m/s²) at about 39 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 2.3 km mark; there was a bump around the 2.8 km mark.
- Harbour Way (2.8–3.5 km), 690 m: ride very rough (1.5 m/s²) at about 43 km/h; surface in poor condition; there was possibly a jolt around the 3.3 km mark.
- Meadow Way (3.5–3.8 km), 330 m: ride bumpy (1.2 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 3.7 km mark.
- Harvest Lane (6.1–7.8 km), 1.7 km: ride very rough (2.1 m/s²) at about 41 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.4 m/s²; there were two sharp bumps around the 6.9 and 7.8 km marks.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.6 km: ride comfortable; two lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Lantern Lane (0.3–1.8 km) for a maintenance review.

Trip report: 7.6 km drive, 13 minutes.
- Willow Drive (2.5–4.0 km), 1.5 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.82 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.4 m/s²; near Primary School; there was a sharp bump around the 3.5 km mark.
- Meadow Way (4.0–4.4 km), 440 m: ride rough (1.1 m/s²) at about 44 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.3 m/s²; near Post Office; there was a sharp bump around the 4.1 km mark.
- Brook Lane (4.4–6.3 km), 1.9 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.60 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; near Post Office; rougher than usual; there was probably a swerve around the 5.0 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there was a bump around the 5.7 km mark.
- Brook Lane (6.3–7.6 km), 1.3 km: ride uncomfortable (1.3 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.5 m/s²; the map lists it as cobblestone, but it rides like asphalt; rougher than usual; there was possibly a bump around the 6.5 km mark; there was a bump around the 6.7 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.5 km: ride mildly bumpy to fairly uncomfortable; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Willow Drive (2.5–4.0 km) for a maintenance review.

It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.5 m/s². There was a sharp bump. The map has no street name for it. The roughest stretch was Granary Lane, which felt extremely uncomfortable. It runs near Town Hall. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 11.4 m/s². There were two bumps. There was also probably a bump. Factory Road was smoother than Granary Lane and felt fairly uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.6 m/s². There were two sharp bumps around the 3.3 and 3.5 km marks. Victoria Road was rougher than Factory Road and felt extremely uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 9.1 m/s². There were two bumps. There was also probably a bump. Riverside Drive (5.3–6.0 km) is in excellent condition and felt mildly bumpy at about 35 km/h (0.34 m/s² weighted). It runs near Primary School. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.2 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 5.5 km mark. The other three stretches (2.0 km) ranged from perfectly comfortable to fairly bumpy, with one lower-priority event. Granary Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Trip report: 7.7 km drive, 30 minutes.
- Ridge Road (0.0–1.1 km), 1.1 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.85 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 0.1 km mark; there was probably a jolt around the 0.5 km mark.
- Ridge Road (1.1–2.6 km), 1.5 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.62 m/s²) at about 10 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; the map lists it as cobblestone, but it rides like an unpaved road; there were two hard bumps around the 1.3 and 2.4 km marks; there was likely a bump around the 2.3 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- the stretch from 2.6 to 3.2 km, 610 m: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.51 m/s²) at about 11 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.8 m/s²; there was probably a jolt around the 2.7 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 2.9 km mark; there was likely a bump around the 3.0 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low); map match failed, no street name.
- Orchard Lane (3.2–3.7 km), 530 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.87 m/s²) at about 59 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.6 m/s²; there was likely a jolt around the 3.3 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 3.5 km mark.
- Castle Street (3.7–4.1 km), 410 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.78 m/s²) at about 26 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.0 m/s²; the map lists it as sett, but it rides like an unpaved road; there was possibly a jolt around the 3.8 km mark; there was a bump around the 4.0 km mark.
- Castle Street (4.1–5.4 km), 1.3 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.52 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like cobblestones; there was probably a bump around the 4.4 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Market Street (5.4–6.1 km), 680 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.85 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.9 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 5.5 and 5.9 km marks.
- Granary Lane (6.1–7.7 km), 1.6 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.81 m/s²) at about 26 km/h; surface in fair condition; there was likely a jolt around the 6.4 km mark.
- Action: flag Ridge Road (0.0–1.1 km) for a maintenance review.

- Action: flag Linden Avenue (0.7–1.9 km) for a maintenance review.

- the stretch from 3.7 to 5.7 km, 2.0 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.44 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; there was possibly a jolt around the 4.7 km mark; there was likely a bump around the 5.0 km mark.

- the stretch from 7.1 to 8.6 km, 1.5 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.73 m/s²) at about 58 km/h; surface in good condition.
- the stretch from 8.6 to 9.2 km, 540 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.41 m/s²); surface in excellent condition.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.0 km: ride perfectly comfortable to mildly bumpy; one lower-priority event.

narrative: Your 5.4 km run took 9 minutes. Without a gyroscope, steering events could not be checked. Orchard Lane (0.0–1.1 km) felt bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 78 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in fair condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.1 m/s². There was probably a bump. There was also a sharp bump. Orchard Lane (1.1–2.6 km) felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 69 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition. It runs near Sports Ground. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.0 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 1.3 km mark. There was also possibly a jolt around the 1.5 km mark. There was also likely a jolt around the 1.7 km mark. Orchard Lane (2.6–2.9 km) is in fair condition and felt fairly bumpy at about 29 km/h. It runs near Fire Station. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.6 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as paving stones. There were three bumps. Chapel Street (400 m) was rougher than Orchard Lane (2.6–2.9 km) and felt bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.1 m/s². There was a hard bump. There was also possibly a jolt. Mill Road is in very poor condition and felt bumpy (1.3 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.2 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as paving stones. There was a hard bump around the 5.3 km mark. The other two stretches (1.6 km) ranged from noticeably bumpy to uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Orchard Lane (0.0–1.1 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 6.0 km drive, 16 minutes.
- Harbour Way (0.0–1.1 km), 1.1 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.85 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.5 m/s²; the map lists it as cobblestone, but it rides like an unpaved road; there was a hard bump around the 0.2 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Mill Road (1.1–2.5 km), 1.4 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.37 m/s²) at about 17 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.87 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 1.3 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 1.9 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Pottery Lane (2.5–3.3 km), 750 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.38 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; there was a bump around the 2.7 km mark; there may have been a bump around the 2.8 km mark.
- Hill Road (3.3–4.3 km), 990 m: ride rough (0.95 m/s²); surface not rated (speed too low).
- Victoria Road (4.3–6.0 km), 1.7 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.87 m/s²) at about 79 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.5 m/s²; there was likely a jolt around the 4.8 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 5.3 km mark.
- Action: flag Harbour Way (0.0–1.1 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 10.0 km run took 19 minutes. Factory Road (0.0–0.8 km) is in fair condition and felt noticeably bumpy (0.77 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.6 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 0.3 km mark. There was also a hard bump around the 0.7 km mark. On Factory Road (0.8–2.3 km) the surface is in fair condition, and at about 61 km/h it felt fairly bumpy. There may have been a jolt around the 1.1 km mark. There may also have been a swerve around the 1.8 km mark, possibly around an obstacle. There may also have been a bump around the 2.0 km mark. Harvest Lane (2.3–3.5 km) is in fair condition and felt fairly bumpy. It runs near Bus Depot. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.6 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as unpaved. There was possibly a jolt. There was also a bump. Harvest Lane (3.5–5.6 km) is in fair condition and felt fairly uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.6 m/s². There was probably a jolt. There was also probably a bump. There was also a sharp bump. Brook Lane is in fair condition and felt fairly bumpy (0.82 m/s² weighted). It runs near Water Tower. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.3 m/s². There may have been a bump around the 5.9 km mark. There was also a bump around the 6.0 km mark. The roughest stretch was Victoria Road (6.3–8.4 km), which felt fairly bumpy (0.89 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.6 m/s². There may have been a swerve around the 6.8 km mark, possibly around an obstacle. There was also a sharp bump around the 8.0 km mark. Victoria Road (8.4–9.7 km) was smoother than Victoria Road (6.3–8.4 km) and felt noticeably bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.1 m/s². There was a sharp bump. The other stretch (330 m) was perfectly comfortable, with no bumps or jolts.

- the stretch from 2.5 to 4.5 km, 2.0 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.50 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; near Swimming Pool; there was a bump around the 4.1 km mark; no street name in the map.
- Riverside Drive (4.5–5.9 km), 1.4 km: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.61 m/s²) at about 39 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.7 m/s²; there were three bumps around the 4.6, 4.8 and 5.4 km marks.
- Kings Road (5.9–7.7 km), 1.8 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.45 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; the map lists it as paving stones, but it rides like an unpaved road; there was a hard bump around the 6.0 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 7.4 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Harvest Lane (9.9–10.7 km), 730 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.62 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; near Central Station; there was a sharp bump around the 10.5 km mark.
- The remaining four stretches, 4.7 km: ride perfectly comfortable to fairly bumpy; four lower-priority events.
- Action: flag the stretch from 2.5 to 4.5 km for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 8.8 km run took 16 minutes. On Ashgrove Road the surface is in poor condition, and at about 34 km/h it felt rough (0.97 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.4 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as paving stones. There was a bump. Harbour Way (0.8–2.4 km) was smoother than Ashgrove Road and felt noticeably bumpy (0.70 m/s² weighted). It runs near Town Hall. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.6 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as paving stones. There was a bump around the 1.3 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. Beacon Way (4.9–7.2 km) is in fair condition and felt fairly bumpy at about 65 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.5 m/s². There were two bumps around the 4.9 and 6.8 km marks. There was also probably a bump around the 6.5 km mark. Beacon Way (7.2–7.8 km) was smoother than Beacon Way (4.9–7.2 km) and felt slightly uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.0 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 7.7 km mark. The roughest stretch was Beacon Way (7.8–8.8 km), which felt uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.9 m/s². There were likely two bumps. The other two stretches (2.5 km) ranged from calm to a little uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Ashgrove Road is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative:
Trip report: 9.4 km drive, 14 minutes.
- Harbour Way (0.0–2.1 km), 2.1 km: ride calm (0.26 m/s²) at about 36 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.83 m/s²; near Water Tower; there was a sharp bump around the 0.4 km mark; there was likely a bump around the 1.5 km mark.
- Forest Road (2.1–2.8 km), 740 m: ride rough (1.3 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.6 m/s²; there were two hard bumps around the 2.1 and 2.5 km marks.
- Granary Lane (3.5–5.4 km), 1.9 km: ride perfectly comfortable (0.23 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.78 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 3.6 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 5.4 km mark.
- Granary Lane (5.4–7.6 km), 2.2 km: ride uncomfortable (1.0 m/s²) at about 66 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.6 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 6.9 km mark.
- Factory Road (7.6–8.5 km), 870 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.45 m/s²) at about 32 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; there were two hard bumps around the 7.6 and 8.1 km marks.
- Factory Road (8.5–8.9 km), 420 m: ride rough (1.0 m/s²) at about 36 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.6 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 8.5 and 8.6 km marks.
- Orchard Lane (8.9–9.4 km), 530 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.88 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there was a bump around the 9.2 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 660 m: ride noticeably bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Harbour Way (0.0–2.1 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 10.0 km run took 19 minutes. Chapel Street is in fair condition and felt fairly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.0 m/s². There may have been a bump around the 0.4 km mark. There were also likely two bumps around the 0.8 and 1.0 km marks. On Farm Track the surface is in good condition, and at about 53 km/h it felt a little uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.2 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 1.7 km mark. Copper Street (4.0–4.5 km) felt extremely rough mostly because of speed: at about 46 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in very poor condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 9.1 m/s². There were likely two bumps around the 4.4 and 4.5 km marks. Copper Street (4.5–6.6 km) was smoother than Copper Street (4.0–4.5 km) and felt noticeably bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.2 m/s². It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as unpaved. There were three hard bumps around the 5.3, 6.2 and 6.3 km marks. Pottery Lane was rougher than Copper Street (4.5–6.6 km) and felt punishing (3.1 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 7.5 m/s². There were two sharp bumps around the 7.6 and 8.1 km marks. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. A 73-second GPS gap means its exact position is uncertain. On Harbour Way (8.4–9.1 km) the surface is in very poor condition, and overall it felt very rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.8 m/s². There was likely a bump around the 8.6 km mark. There was also likely a jolt around the 8.9 km mark. There was also a bump around the 9.0 km mark. Harbour Way (9.1–10.0 km) was smoother than Harbour Way (8.4–9.1 km) and felt rough (1.3 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.5 m/s². There was a bump around the 9.2 km mark. The other stretch (660 m) was very rough, with no bumps or jolts. Copper Street (4.0–4.5 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Trip report: 3.4 km drive, 7 minutes.
- Linden Avenue (1.3–1.7 km), 410 m: ride extremely rough (3.4 m/s²) at about 30 km/h; surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 9.6 m/s²; near General Hospital; there was probably a bump around the 1.5 km mark.
- Ferry Road (1.7–2.5 km), 840 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.62 m/s²) at about 45 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; there was a bump around the 2.0 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 2.2 km mark.
- Elm Avenue (2.5–3.4 km), 880 m: ride very bumpy (1.5 m/s²) at about 29 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.3 m/s²; the map lists it as gravel, but it rides like cobblestones; there was a sharp bump around the 2.7 km mark; there were probably two bumps around the 2.9 and 3.1 km marks.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.3 km: ride mildly bumpy to very bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Linden Avenue (1.3–1.7 km) for a maintenance review.

Trip report: 9.6 km drive, 20 minutes.
- Castle Street (0.0–1.2 km), 1.2 km: ride calm (0.27 m/s²) at about 61 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.93 m/s²; near Water Tower; the same as usual; there was a sharp bump around the 0.8 km mark.
- Ashgrove Road (1.4–3.1 km), 1.7 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.35 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.72 m/s²; there was likely a jolt around the 2.3 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 2.4 km mark; there may have been a jolt around the 2.6 km mark.
- Ashgrove Road (3.1–4.8 km), 1.7 km: ride uncomfortable (0.95 m/s²) at about 22 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.5 m/s²; there were three bumps around the 3.3, 3.8 and 3.9 km marks.
- Farm Track (4.8–6.0 km), 1.2 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.61 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; near City Library; there was a hard bump around the 5.3 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 5.5 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Farm Track (6.0–7.9 km), 1.9 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.73 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; smoother than usual; there were two sharp bumps around the 6.9 and 7.5 km marks.
- Granary Lane (7.9–8.2 km), 310 m: ride bumpy (1.1 m/s²); surface in fair condition; there may have been a swerve around the 7.9 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- The remaining two stretches, 1.6 km: ride bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Castle Street (0.0–1.2 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 6.5 km run took 14 minutes. Castle Street felt slightly uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 77 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in excellent condition. There was probably a jolt around the 0.4 km mark. The ride on Church Lane (3.3–3.9 km) was fairly bumpy (0.67 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.1 m/s². There were probably two bumps around the 3.6 and 3.8 km marks. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. Victoria Road was rougher than Church Lane (3.3–3.9 km) and felt extremely rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 7.7 m/s². There was a hard bump. On Beacon Way (4.1–4.8 km) the ride was bumpy (1.2 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.4 m/s². There was probably a jolt. There was also a sharp bump. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. On Beacon Way (4.8–6.5 km) the surface is in poor condition, and at about 33 km/h it felt bumpy (1.4 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.0 m/s². There was likely a bump around the 5.7 km mark. The other stretch (1.8 km) was comfortable, with two lower-priority events. Victoria Road is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative: Your 5.2 km run took 9 minutes. On Chapel Street the surface is in fair condition, and at about 21 km/h it felt fairly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.95 m/s². There was a hard bump. The roughest stretch was Factory Road, which felt very uncomfortable (1.5 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.6 m/s². There were three sharp bumps. Signal Way felt noticeably bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 69 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition. It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as asphalt. Victoria Road felt a little uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 54 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in excellent condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.81 m/s². There were two bumps around the 2.7 and 4.3 km marks. There was also possibly a jolt around the 3.8 km mark. On Kings Road the surface is in fair condition, and at about 20 km/h it felt fairly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.95 m/s². There was a sharp bump. The other two stretches (720 m) ranged from comfortable to a little uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Factory Road is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 6.8 m/s². There was a bump around the 1.1 km mark. There was also possibly a bump around the 1.4 km mark. There were two bumps around the 2.0 and 3.4 km marks. There was also likely a bump around the 2.2 km mark. Church Lane (440 m) is in very poor condition and felt very rough (1.7 m/s² weighted). On Canal Road (4.1–6.3 km) the surface is in excellent condition, and at about 37 km/h it felt a little uncomfortable (0.33 m/s² weighted). Canal Road (6.3–7.1 km) is in fair condition and felt noticeably bumpy (0.57 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.2 m/s². narrative:
Trip report: 4.9 km drive, 20 minutes.
- Ferry Road (2.4–3.2 km), 850 m: ride very bumpy (1.8 m/s²) at about 14 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 6.6 m/s²; near Fire Station; there were two hard bumps around the 2.5 and 2.6 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Pottery Lane (3.2–4.1 km), 890 m: ride bumpy (1.1 m/s²); surface in poor condition; near Fire Station; there may have been a bump around the 3.9 km mark.
- Pottery Lane (4.1–4.5 km), 340 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.72 m/s²) at about 39 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; there was a bump around the 4.2 km mark; there may have been a swerve around the 4.4 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.8 km: ride perfectly comfortable to very rough; two lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Ferry Road (2.4–3.2 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Here is your 13-minute, 6.3 km drive. No map data was available, so places are given as distances. The stretch from 0.0 to 0.6 km felt a little uncomfortable mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in excellent condition. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump. The stretch from 0.6 to 1.4 km was rougher than the stretch from 0.0 to 0.6 km and felt noticeably bumpy. It was jarring in places. A jolt around the 1.1 km mark may have come from pulling away rather than from the road. There was also a sharp bump around the 1.3 km mark. On the stretch from 1.4 to 2.5 km the ride was bumpy. It was jarring in places. There may have been a bump. There was also a bump. On the stretch from 2.5 to 4.1 km the ride was fairly uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There were two sharp bumps. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. On the stretch from 4.1 to 5.5 km the ride was very rough. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump around the 5.0 km mark. The ride on the stretch from 5.5 to 6.0 km was uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There was a bump. There may also have been a bump. The other stretch was extremely uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on the stretch from 4.1 to 5.5 km next time should make for a gentler ride.

narrative: Your 4.2 km run took 8 minutes. On Hill Road the surface is in poor condition, and overall it felt bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.8 m/s². There was a bump around the 0.3 km mark. Ridge Road is in fair condition and felt noticeably bumpy at about 27 km/h (0.74 m/s² weighted). It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as dirt. The stretch from 1.1 to 2.1 km was smoother than Ridge Road and felt mildly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.76 m/s². There may have been two jolts. There was also a hard bump. The map has no street name for it. On Brook Lane (600 m) the surface is in poor condition, and at about 21 km/h it felt bumpy (0.91 m/s² weighted). On Station Street (3.1–4.2 km) the surface is badly broken up, and overall it felt extremely uncomfortable (2.4 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 8.7 m/s². That is about the same as usual on this route. There were three sharp bumps around the 3.2, 3.6 and 3.8 km marks. The other stretch (400 m) was calm, with no bumps or jolts. Station Street (3.1–4.2 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as asphalt. There may have been a jolt around the 1.4 km mark. There were also likely two jolts around the 2.1 and 2.4 km marks. Garden Row was rougher than Linden Avenue (1.0–3.0 km) and felt punishing. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 9.4 m/s². There may have been a bump. There was also probably a bump. On Signal Way (2.3 km) the surface is in good condition, and overall it felt mildly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.99 m/s². There were likely two bumps around the 4.2 and 5.6 km marks. There was also possibly a bump around the 4.7 km mark. On the stretch from 6.2 to 8.0 km the surface is in fair condition, and at about 79 km/h it felt fairly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.0 m/s². There were two bumps. The map has no street name for it. The stretch from 8.0 to 10.2 km is in poor condition and felt bumpy at about 41 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.9 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as asphalt. There was probably a bump. There was also a sharp bump. There was also probably a jolt. The map has no street name for it. Market Street (1.0 km) was smoother than the stretch from 8.0 to 10.2 km and felt noticeably bumpy. There was possibly a jolt. The other stretch (980 m) was calm, with one lower-priority event. Garden Row is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Brook Lane is in good condition and felt slightly uncomfortable. Copper Street felt fairly uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 64 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition (0.65 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.7 m/s². There were two bumps around the 2.5 and 4.2 km marks. Bridge Street (4.7–5.0 km) was rougher than Copper Street and felt very rough (1.6 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.3 m/s². It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as gravel. There was a sharp bump. On Bridge Street (5.0–7.1 km) the surface is in poor condition, and overall it felt uncomfortable. It runs near Swimming Pool. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.5 m/s². It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as unpaved. There were three hard bumps around the 5.9, 6.5 and 6.9 km marks. The other stretch (1.4 km) was perfectly comfortable, with one lower-priority event. Bridge Street (4.7–5.0 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- Garden Row (0.0–1.6 km), 1.6 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.35 m/s²) at about 26 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; the map lists it as paving stones, but it rides like asphalt; there were two hard bumps around the 0.5 and 1.2 km marks.
- Garden Row (1.6–3.7 km), 2.1 km: ride very uncomfortable (2.1 m/s²); surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 7.4 m/s²; there were two hard bumps around the 2.3 and 2.9 km marks.
- School Lane (4.3–4.9 km), 620 m: ride very bumpy (2.1 m/s²) at about 27 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 7.4 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; smoother than usual; there was likely a bump around the 4.4 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 4.6 km mark.
- Mill Road (7.2–8.2 km), 930 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.75 m/s²) at about 26 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; smoother than usual; there was probably a bump around the 7.3 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 7.5 km mark.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.9 km: ride comfortable to very uncomfortable; three lower-priority events.
- Action: flag Garden Row (0.0–1.6 km) for a maintenance review.

The other two stretches (3.3 km) were perfectly comfortable, with no bumps or jolts.

narrative:
Trip report: 12.1 km drive, 15 minutes.
- Meadow Way (0.3–1.1 km), 780 m: ride mildly bumpy (0.40 m/s²) at about 27 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.87 m/s²; there was a bump around the 0.7 km mark.
- Meadow Way (1.1–3.0 km), 1.9 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.37 m/s²) at about 72 km/h; surface in excellent condition; near Petrol Station; there was probably a jolt around the 3.0 km mark.
- Ferry Road (3.0–4.4 km), 1.4 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.60 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; near Petrol Station; there were two sharp bumps around the 3.2 and 3.9 km marks; there may have been a swerve around the 3.5 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- Ferry Road (4.4–6.3 km), 1.9 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.58 m/s²) at about 56 km/h; surface in good condition; there was likely a jolt around the 4.6 km mark; there may have been two jolts around the 5.0 and 6.2 km marks.
- Ferry Road (6.3–7.7 km), 1.4 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.53 m/s²) at about 48 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; there was probably a jolt around the 6.7 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 7.4 km mark.
- Ferry Road (7.7–9.9 km), 2.2 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.82 m/s²) at about 69 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 8.9 km mark; there was probably a swerve around the 9.8 km mark, likely around an obstacle.
- School Lane (9.9–12.1 km), 2.2 km: ride perfectly comfortable (0.20 m/s²) at about 35 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.59 m/s²; there was possibly a bump around the 10.0 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 10.7 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 310 m: ride noticeably bumpy; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Meadow Way (0.3–1.1 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 10.1 km drive, 16 minutes.
- Hill Road (0.0–2.3 km), 2.3 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.45 m/s²) at about 44 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.3 m/s²; rougher than usual; there was a hard bump around the 1.4 km mark.
- Willow Drive (2.3–3.5 km), 1.2 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.77 m/s²) at about 35 km/h; surface in fair condition; rougher than usual.
- Brook Lane (3.9–6.3 km), 2.4 km: ride very bumpy (2.1 m/s²) at about 61 km/h; surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.4 m/s²; the same as usual; there were two sharp bumps around the 4.4 and 5.1 km marks; there was probably a swerve around the 6.1 km mark, likely around an obstacle.
- Brook Lane (6.3–6.6 km), 250 m: ride very rough (1.5 m/s²) at about 15 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.3 m/s²; rougher than usual; there were three hard bumps around the 6.4, 6.4 and 6.5 km marks; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Victoria Road (6.6–8.3 km), 1.8 km: ride uncomfortable (0.91 m/s²) at about 54 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.9 m/s²; rougher than usual; there was likely a bump around the 7.1 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 7.4 km mark.
- Market Street (9.5–10.1 km), 660 m: ride rough (1.0 m/s²) at about 12 km/h; surface not rated (speed too low).
- The remaining two stretches, 1.5 km: ride calm to fairly uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Hill Road (0.0–2.3 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 6.8 km drive took 10 minutes. Farm Track felt punishing mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in very poor condition. It was jarring in places. There were two hard bumps. Bridge Street (2.6–3.3 km) felt rough. It was jarring in places. It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as paving stones. There may have been a swerve, possibly around an obstacle. There was also a hard bump. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. Bridge Street (3.3–3.9 km) was smoother than Bridge Street (2.6–3.3 km) and felt fairly uncomfortable. There was probably a swerve, likely around an obstacle. The ride on Brook Lane was very uncomfortable, and the surface itself is in poor condition. It was jarring in places. There were two bumps as you braked. There was also a sharp bump. Ashgrove Road felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in good condition. It was jarring in places. There was probably a bump. The other three stretches ranged from mildly bumpy to extremely rough, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on Farm Track next time should make for a gentler ride.

narrative: The ride on Willow Drive was bumpy. A jolt may have come from pulling away rather than from the road. On Signal Way (0.3–0.9 km) the ride was very rough. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump. Elm Avenue (2.8–3.3 km) felt very bumpy. It runs near Primary School. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump. There was also a hard bump as you braked. Elm Avenue (3.3–4.6 km) felt very bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was likely a bump. There was also a sharp bump. There was also possibly a bump. The roughest stretch was the stretch from 5.4 to 6.1 km, which felt punishing. A jolt may have come from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The map has no street name for it. The other three stretches ranged from calm to slightly uncomfortable, with three lower-priority events. Gentler braking and a slower pace on the stretch from 5.4 to 6.1 km would help most.

narrative:
Trip report: 7.2 km drive, 18 minutes.
- School Lane (0.9–2.0 km), 1.1 km: ride extremely uncomfortable (2.3 m/s²); surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 8.1 m/s²; there was a bump around the 1.1 km mark; there was probably a bump around the 1.6 km mark; there was possibly a jolt around the 1.9 km mark.
- the stretch from 2.0 to 3.1 km, 1.2 km: ride very uncomfortable (2.0 m/s²) at about 14 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.8 m/s²; the map lists it as cobblestone, but it rides like an unpaved road; there was a hard bump around the 2.3 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low); no street name in the map.
- School Lane (3.1–3.5 km), 360 m: ride rough (0.95 m/s²) at about 9 km/h; surface not rated (speed too low).
- School Lane (3.5–3.9 km), 370 m: ride bumpy (0.95 m/s²) at about 39 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.2 m/s²; near Sports Ground; there was a bump around the 3.7 km mark.
- School Lane (3.9–4.2 km), 300 m: ride uncomfortable (1.1 m/s²) at about 19 km/h; surface in poor condition; near Petrol Station.
- Granary Lane (6.5–7.2 km), 660 m: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.46 m/s²) at about 19 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; there were two bumps around the 6.6 and 6.9 km marks.
- The remaining two stretches, 3.2 km: ride mildly bumpy to fairly uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag School Lane (0.9–2.0 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 9.7 km run took 15 minutes. Elm Avenue is in good condition and felt a little uncomfortable at about 57 km/h (0.40 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.88 m/s². There may have been a jolt around the 0.2 km mark. There was also likely a bump around the 0.7 km mark. Quarry Lane was rougher than Elm Avenue and felt noticeably bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.6 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 1.3 km mark. There was also possibly a jolt around the 2.1 km mark. Castle Street (3.3–4.0 km) is in poor condition and felt uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.4 m/s². There was a sharp bump. Castle Street (4.0–4.4 km) was smoother than Castle Street (3.3–4.0 km) and felt fairly uncomfortable (0.74 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.0 m/s². There was a hard bump. There may also have been a jolt. The stretch from 4.4 to 6.6 km felt slightly uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 44 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in excellent condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.1 m/s². There were two hard bumps. There was also likely a bump. The map has no street name for it. On Castle Street (6.6–8.2 km) the surface is in poor condition, and at about 20 km/h it felt rough (1.2 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.1 m/s². It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as dirt. There were three sharp bumps around the 7.5, 7.8 and 7.9 km marks. On Meadow Way (210 m) the surface is in poor condition, and at about 38 km/h it felt rough (1.1 m/s² weighted). There may have been a bump around the 9.6 km mark. The other stretch (1.4 km) was rough, with no bumps or jolts. Castle Street (3.3–4.0 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- The remaining five stretches, 3.2 km: ride perfectly comfortable to uncomfortable; one lower-priority event.
- Action: flag Lantern Lane (1.2–3.0 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 8.7 km run took 18 minutes. Ridge Road is in excellent condition and felt calm at about 51 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.30 m/s². There was likely a jolt around the 0.5 km mark. There may also have been a jolt around the 1.3 km mark. There was also likely a bump around the 1.4 km mark. On Brook Lane the surface is in very poor condition, and at about 32 km/h it felt very bumpy (2.1 m/s² weighted). Mill Road is in good condition and felt mildly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.9 m/s². There were two hard bumps around the 6.2 and 6.3 km marks. The ride on Station Street was fairly uncomfortable at about 17 km/h. There may have been a jolt around the 7.8 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The ride on Hill Road was rough at about 12 km/h (1.2 m/s² weighted). It runs near Retail Park. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.5 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 8.5 km mark. The other three stretches (2.5 km) ranged from slightly uncomfortable to fairly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Brook Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- Action: flag Market Street (2.5–3.6 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 8.9 km run took 10 minutes. Victoria Road is in fair condition and felt fairly bumpy (0.74 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.2 m/s². There was probably a bump. Orchard Lane was rougher than Victoria Road and felt rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.4 m/s². There was likely a bump around the 1.7 km mark. There may also have been a jolt around the 2.2 km mark. There was also a hard bump around the 2.7 km mark. The stretch from 3.1 to 5.0 km was smoother than Orchard Lane and felt fairly bumpy (0.73 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.9 m/s². There were two sharp bumps around the 4.4 and 5.0 km marks. The map has no street name for it. Farm Track (5.0–6.5 km) was the smoothest stretch and felt perfectly comfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.80 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 6.0 km mark. Tannery Row felt noticeably bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 66 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition (0.74 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.7 m/s². There was possibly a jolt. There were also two bumps. The other stretch (1.2 km) was a little uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Orchard Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

narrative: Your 7.3 km drive took 17 minutes. The roughest stretch was Weavers Way, which felt very uncomfortable. There may have been a bump around the 0.3 km mark. Abbey Street was smoother than Weavers Way and felt bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump around the 0.6 km mark as you braked. There was also a sharp bump around the 0.7 km mark. Hill Road was smoother than Abbey Street and felt perfectly comfortable. It was jarring in places. There may have been a swerve around the 1.1 km mark, possibly around an obstacle. There was also a hard bump around the 1.4 km mark. On Station Street (3.8–4.8 km) the ride was uncomfortable. It was jarring in places. There was a hard bump around the 3.9 km mark as you braked. There was also possibly a bump around the 4.1 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. On Station Street (4.8–5.4 km) the ride was very rough. It was jarring in places. There was a bump. On Granary Lane the ride was bumpy, and the surface itself is in poor condition. It was jarring in places. There was a bump. The ride on Castle Street was very bumpy. It was jarring in places. There were two sharp bumps around the 6.2 and 6.9 km marks. The other stretch was a little uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on Weavers Way next time should make for a gentler ride.

narrative: Your 5.6 km run took 10 minutes. Riverside Drive (0.0–1.6 km) felt a little uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 49 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in excellent condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.83 m/s². There was probably a bump around the 1.2 km mark. There was also a hard bump around the 1.3 km mark. Riverside Drive (1.6–2.3 km) was rougher than Riverside Drive (0.0–1.6 km) and felt very rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 6.4 m/s². There was a hard bump. North Ring is in good condition and felt fairly bumpy at about 38 km/h (0.59 m/s² weighted). It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as compacted. There was probably a jolt. On School Lane the surface is in good condition, and overall it felt slightly uncomfortable (0.43 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.1 m/s². There was likely a bump around the 3.3 km mark. On Quarry Lane (3.4–4.2 km) the surface is in poor condition, and overall it felt bumpy. It runs near Petrol Station. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.6 m/s². There was likely a bump. On Quarry Lane (4.2–4.8 km) the surface is in very poor condition, and at about 42 km/h it felt very bumpy. There may have been a jolt around the 4.5 km mark. Abbey Street was smoother than Quarry Lane (4.2–4.8 km) and felt noticeably bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.2 m/s². There was a sharp bump. The other stretch (400 m) was fairly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Riverside Drive (1.6–2.3 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

That is smoother than usual on this route. The other stretch (220 m) was mildly bumpy, with no bumps or jolts.

- Forest Road (1.3–2.2 km), 910 m: ride rough (1.3 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.4 m/s²; there was a hard bump around the 1.4 km mark.

- Harbour Way (4.5–6.4 km), 1.9 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.32 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; there was a jolt around the 4.7 km mark.

- The remaining two stretches, 1.6 km: ride perfectly comfortable to slightly uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Forest Road (1.3–2.2 km) for a maintenance review.

- Kings Road (3.7–5.9 km), 2.2 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.41 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.4 m/s²; there were two sharp bumps around the 4.5 and 4.9 km marks.

narrative: Here is your 11-minute, 7.1 km drive. Ferry Road (0.0–1.4 km) felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed; the surface itself is in good condition. It was jarring in places. It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as asphalt. There was probably a bump as you braked. There was also a bump. On Ferry Road (1.4–2.2 km) the ride was noticeably bumpy, and the surface itself is in fair condition. It runs near Post Office. It was jarring in places. There was probably a bump. Ferry Road (2.2–3.2 km) felt fairly uncomfortable. It runs near Primary School. There may have been a bump around the 3.0 km mark. A jolt around the 3.1 km mark probably came from stop-and-go driving rather than from the road. The ride on Orchard Lane was mildly bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was a bump around the 3.8 km mark. The other four stretches ranged from comfortable to fairly uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts.

- Willow Drive (0.0–2.4 km), 2.4 km: ride calm (0.26 m/s²) at about 49 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.93 m/s²; the map lists it as compacted, but it rides like asphalt; near Old Mill; there may have been a jolt around the 1.2 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 1.4 km mark.
- Harvest Lane (2.4–2.7 km), 250 m: ride very rough (1.7 m/s²); surface in very poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 5.6 m/s²; near Level Crossing; there was likely a bump around the 2.5 km mark.
- Tannery Row (2.7–4.5 km), 1.8 km: ride noticeably bumpy (0.76 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.2 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; near Level Crossing; there was a hard bump around the 3.4 km mark.
- Action: flag Willow Drive (0.0–2.4 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 4.0 km drive took 12 minutes. Chapel Street felt rough. It was jarring in places. There were two hard bumps around the 0.3 and 0.7 km marks. Linden Avenue (0.8–1.3 km) was rougher than Chapel Street and felt very bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was a bump. Linden Avenue (1.3–1.9 km) was smoother than Linden Avenue (0.8–1.3 km) and felt fairly bumpy. A jolt around the 1.8 km mark probably came from pulling away rather than from the road. Forest Road felt very rough. It was jarring in places. There were probably two bumps. There was also a bump. On Canal Road the ride was mildly bumpy. It was jarring in places. There was a sharp bump. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The other two stretches ranged from calm to extremely uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Easing off on Linden Avenue (0.8–1.3 km) next time should make for a gentler ride.

There was also a sharp bump around the 0.7 km mark. Kings Road (2.3 km) was rougher than Mill Road and felt rough (1.3 m/s² weighted). It runs near Bus Depot. Signal Way (3.9–4.5 km) was rougher than Kings Road and felt extremely uncomfortable. Signal Way (4.5–6.0 km) is in excellent condition and felt comfortable (0.27 m/s² weighted). Quarry Lane was rougher than Signal Way (4.5–6.0 km) and felt mildly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.88 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 6.0 km mark. Signal Way (3.9–4.5 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.
