narrative:
Trip report: 6.6 km drive, 12 minutes.
- Kings Road (0.0–1.6 km), 1.6 km: ride extremely rough (3.5 m/s²) at about 35 km/h; surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 11.6 m/s²; near Old Mill; there were likely two bumps around the 0.4 and 0.6 km marks; there was a bump around the 1.0 km mark.
- the stretch from 1.6 to 2.9 km, 1.3 km: ride uncomfortable (0.99 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.5 m/s²; there may have been a bump around the 1.7 km mark; there was a sharp bump around the 2.3 km mark; there was likely a jolt around the 2.5 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low); no street name in the map.
- Garden Row (2.9–5.3 km), 2.4 km: ride comfortable (0.21 m/s²) at about 54 km/h; surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.69 m/s²; near Level Crossing; there was a hard bump around the 4.2 km mark.
- Garden Row (5.3–6.0 km), 640 m: ride bumpy (1.1 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.6 m/s²; the map lists it as asphalt, but it rides like an unpaved road; there were two sharp bumps around the 5.4 and 5.7 km marks; there was possibly a bump around the 5.8 km mark.
- Lantern Lane (6.0–6.6 km), 670 m: ride rough (0.93 m/s²) at about 46 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; near Central Station; there was a sharp bump around the 6.5 km mark.
- Action: flag Kings Road (0.0–1.6 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative:
Trip report: 7.2 km drive, 16 minutes.
- Meadow Way (0.0–0.9 km), 890 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.62 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.1 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 0.8 km mark.
- Willow Drive (0.9–2.4 km), 1.5 km: ride uncomfortable (0.93 m/s²) at about 38 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.6 m/s²; there was a bump around the 1.9 km mark.
- Mill Road (2.4–2.7 km), 390 m: ride noticeably bumpy (0.88 m/s²) at about 23 km/h; surface in poor condition.
- Canal Road (2.7–3.6 km), 890 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.43 m/s²); surface not rated (speed too low).
- Pottery Lane (3.6–5.6 km), 2.0 km: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.46 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.2 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 4.2 km mark.
- Hill Road (5.6–7.2 km), 1.5 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.71 m/s²) at about 17 km/h; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.7 m/s²; there were possibly two jolts around the 5.7 and 6.9 km marks; there was a hard bump around the 6.6 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Action: flag Meadow Way (0.0–0.9 km) for a maintenance review.

- Station Street (4.0–5.9 km), 1.9 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.51 m/s²); surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.5 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 4.5 km mark; there was a bump around the 4.6 km mark; there was possibly a bump around the 5.7 km mark.
- Action: flag Victoria Road (0.0–0.5 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 10.8 km run took 23 minutes. Factory Road (1.5 km) was the smoothest stretch and felt calm. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.65 m/s². There was a bump around the 0.9 km mark. The ride on Mill Road was fairly bumpy at about 9 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.7 m/s². It rides like an unpaved road, although the map lists it as asphalt. There was probably a bump around the 1.6 km mark. There was also possibly a jolt around the 2.0 km mark. The roughest stretch was Meadow Way, which felt extremely rough (3.0 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 8.0 m/s². There were three sharp bumps. Beacon Way was smoother than Meadow Way and felt extremely rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 8.2 m/s². It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as paving stones. There was likely a bump around the 3.9 km mark. There were also two sharp bumps around the 4.1 and 4.2 km marks. Ridge Road was smoother than Beacon Way and felt noticeably bumpy (0.66 m/s² weighted). It runs near Town Hall. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.0 m/s². There was possibly a jolt around the 5.3 km mark. There was also a bump around the 5.9 km mark. There was also probably a jolt around the 6.5 km mark. The stretch from 6.8 to 8.5 km is in excellent condition and felt mildly bumpy at about 68 km/h. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.92 m/s². There was a hard bump. The map has no street name for it. The other two stretches (2.3 km) ranged from perfectly comfortable to uncomfortable, with no bumps or jolts. Meadow Way is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- The remaining four stretches, 4.6 km: ride comfortable to fairly uncomfortable; three lower-priority events.

There was a hard bump around the 4.7 km mark. There was also probably a bump around the 5.4 km mark. Bridge Street (5.5–7.0 km) felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 73 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.3 m/s². There was likely a jolt around the 5.8 km mark. There were also two hard bumps around the 6.3 and 6.6 km marks. Brook Lane is in poor condition and felt bumpy (1.1 m/s² weighted). There was possibly a jolt around the 7.0 km mark. The other two stretches (3.0 km) ranged from comfortable to a little uncomfortable, with one lower-priority event. Bridge Street (4.7–5.5 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

- North Ring (0.0–2.5 km), 2.5 km: ride a little uncomfortable (0.47 m/s²) at about 72 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.1 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 0.8 km mark; there was a hard bump around the 1.7 km mark; there was a jolt around the 2.3 km mark.
- North Ring (2.5–3.2 km), 770 m: ride very uncomfortable (1.8 m/s²); surface in very poor condition.
- the stretch from 3.2 to 4.1 km, 820 m: ride fairly uncomfortable (0.61 m/s²) at about 22 km/h; surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.7 m/s²; near Market Hall; there was likely a bump around the 3.3 km mark; there was a bump around the 3.9 km mark; no street name in the map.
- North Ring (4.1–5.6 km), 1.5 km: ride extremely uncomfortable (2.5 m/s²) at about 31 km/h; surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 7.8 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 4.4 km mark; there was probably a swerve around the 4.9 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there was possibly a bump around the 5.4 km mark.
- Action: flag North Ring (0.0–2.5 km) for a maintenance review.

- Tannery Row (3.6–5.2 km), 1.5 km: ride fairly bumpy (0.57 m/s²); surface in fair condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 2.0 m/s²; the map lists it as dirt, but it rides like cobblestones; there was probably a bump around the 3.9 km mark.
- Weavers Way (5.2–5.5 km), 370 m: ride rough (1.2 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.3 m/s²; there were two sharp bumps around the 5.3 and 5.4 km marks; there was likely a jolt around the 5.4 km mark.
- Lantern Lane (5.5–6.4 km), 870 m: ride perfectly comfortable (0.18 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.57 m/s²; the map lists it as unpaved, but it rides like asphalt; there was a bump around the 6.2 km mark; there was likely a jolt around the 6.4 km mark.
- Copper Street (6.4–6.8 km), 380 m: ride rough (1.1 m/s²); surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.9 m/s²; there was probably a bump around the 6.6 km mark.
- Ashgrove Road (6.8–7.2 km), 400 m: ride uncomfortable (1.2 m/s²) at about 44 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.2 m/s²; there was a bump around the 6.9 km mark.
- The remaining stretch, 1.2 km: ride perfectly comfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Market Street (1.2–2.5 km) for a maintenance review.

- Hill Road (6.4–8.8 km), 2.3 km: ride mildly bumpy (0.33 m/s²) at about 45 km/h; surface in excellent condition; there may have been a swerve around the 7.8 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- The remaining two stretches, 2.4 km: ride perfectly comfortable to bumpy; no bumps or jolts.

narrative: Your 8.2 km run took 11 minutes. Without a gyroscope, steering events could not be checked. Canal Road felt fairly uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 74 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition (0.74 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.4 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 0.1 km mark. The roughest stretch was Quarry Lane (900 m), which felt very rough (1.7 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 5.0 m/s². There were two sharp bumps around the 1.3 and 1.5 km marks. Ferry Road is in good condition and felt fairly uncomfortable (0.59 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.9 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 2.7 km mark. There was also possibly a bump around the 3.3 km mark. Chapel Street (5.5–7.5 km) was the smoothest stretch and felt mildly bumpy. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.1 m/s². There was a bump around the 7.5 km mark. Chapel Street (7.5–8.2 km) was rougher than Chapel Street (5.5–7.5 km) and felt fairly bumpy. It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as sett. There may have been a jolt. The other stretch (1.3 km) was fairly bumpy, with no bumps or jolts. Quarry Lane is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Trip report: 5.8 km drive, 12 minutes.
- Victoria Road (0.0–1.3 km), 1.3 km: ride very bumpy (1.5 m/s²); surface in very poor condition; there was probably a swerve around the 0.1 km mark, likely around an obstacle; there was likely a jolt around the 0.7 km mark.
- Meadow Way (1.3–2.7 km), 1.4 km: ride bumpy (1.1 m/s²) at about 25 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.2 m/s²; near Sports Ground; there were three sharp bumps around the 1.5, 1.9 and 2.2 km marks.
- Linden Avenue (3.4–4.2 km), 720 m: ride rough (1.4 m/s²) at about 43 km/h; surface in poor condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 4.9 m/s²; near Central Station; there was possibly a jolt around the 3.8 km mark; there may have been a bump around the 3.9 km mark; there was a bump around the 4.1 km mark.
- Canal Road (4.2–5.0 km), 860 m: ride a little uncomfortable (0.35 m/s²) at about 73 km/h; surface in excellent condition; there may have been a jolt around the 4.2 km mark; there was likely a jolt around the 4.4 km mark.
- Factory Road (5.0–5.5 km), 490 m: ride perfectly comfortable (0.17 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 0.40 m/s²; near Level Crossing; there was a bump around the 5.3 km mark.
- Harvest Lane (5.5–5.8 km), 320 m: ride uncomfortable (1.2 m/s²) at about 25 km/h; surface in poor condition.
- The remaining stretch, 700 m: ride slightly uncomfortable; no bumps or jolts.
- Action: flag Victoria Road (0.0–1.3 km) for a maintenance review.

narrative: Your 7.4 km run took 10 minutes. On Chapel Street the surface is in good condition, and overall it felt a little uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 2.0 m/s². There was possibly a jolt around the 0.4 km mark. There was also a sharp bump around the 1.0 km mark. There was also possibly a bump around the 1.1 km mark. The stretch from 1.4 to 2.5 km felt uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 68 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in fair condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 3.1 m/s². There was a sharp bump around the 2.0 km mark. There was also possibly a bump around the 2.4 km mark. The map has no street name for it. The ride on the stretch from 2.5 to 2.9 km was extremely uncomfortable. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 9.6 m/s². There was a bump around the 2.8 km mark. You were moving too slowly there to separate the road from your speed. The map has no street name for it. Harbour Way was smoother than the stretch from 2.5 to 2.9 km and felt extremely rough. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 4.9 m/s². There was a bump around the 3.0 km mark. On the stretch from 5.5 to 7.4 km the surface is in excellent condition, and overall it felt calm. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.77 m/s². It rides like asphalt, although the map lists it as compacted. There was probably a bump around the 5.8 km mark. There was also possibly a jolt around the 6.0 km mark. The map has no street name for it. The other stretch (2.2 km) was rough, with no bumps or jolts. The stretch from 2.5 to 2.9 km is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Trip report: 4.5 km drive, 7 minutes.
- Granary Lane (0.0–0.8 km), 810 m: ride extremely rough (3.5 m/s²) at about 37 km/h; surface badly broken up; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 12.0 m/s²; there were three bumps around the 0.1, 0.5 and 0.7 km marks.

- Canal Road (2.3–2.7 km), 450 m: ride bumpy (1.1 m/s²); shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 3.4 m/s²; there was a sharp bump around the 2.4 km mark; there was likely a bump around the 2.6 km mark; surface not rated (speed too low).
- Canal Road (2.7–3.7 km), 970 m: ride slightly uncomfortable (0.46 m/s²) at about 76 km/h; surface in good condition; there may have been a swerve around the 3.0 km mark, possibly around an obstacle.
- Bridge Street (3.7–4.0 km), 320 m: ride fairly bumpy (0.65 m/s²) at about 43 km/h; surface in good condition; shock-dominated, peak 1-s exposure 1.8 m/s²; the map lists it as compacted, but it rides like cobblestones; near Town Hall; there was likely a bump around the 4.0 km mark.
- Abbey Street (4.0–4.5 km), 450 m: ride calm (0.11 m/s²); surface in excellent condition; near Town Hall; there was possibly a jolt around the 4.2 km mark.
- Action: flag Granary Lane (0.0–0.8 km) for a maintenance review.

The other stretch (300 m) was bumpy, with no bumps or jolts. Meadow Way (1.5–2.3 km) is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.

Station Street felt fairly uncomfortable mostly because of speed: at about 45 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition. It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.5 m/s². There was a hard bump around the 2.2 km mark. Willow Drive is in poor condition and felt bumpy (1.2 m/s² weighted). It rides like cobblestones, although the map lists it as compacted. There may have been a jolt around the 7.6 km mark. School Lane felt fairly bumpy mostly because of speed: at about 46 km/h you were quick for a surface that is in good condition (0.68 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 1.3 m/s². There was likely a bump. There was also a bump. Factory Road is in good condition and felt mildly bumpy at about 32 km/h (0.48 m/s² weighted). It was shock-dominated, with a peak 1-s exposure of 0.96 m/s². There was a bump. The other three stretches (3.7 km) ranged from a little uncomfortable to rough, with no bumps or jolts. Willow Drive is the place to back off; elsewhere the surface supports a brisk pace.
